wandover-f493314b9c681f32e121d5e1.dek: Ai should be better-looking, and students should be more focused on team direction, job progress and their own waiting costs.
wandover-f493314b9c681f32e121d5e1.body:
Whether Wong In-hoon resigns from Young Weida CEO, Colette Kress or not should be subject to verifiable NVIDIA official announcements and regulatory disclosures, which cannot be confirmed here at this time. For North American Chinese students, even if a management handover is confirmed, it does not amount to a freeze on or suspension of the H1B recruitment; whether or not to continue the application should be based on direct feedback from specific posts, team budgets and recruiter.

Key points

  • Information about Huang In-hoon ' s resignation and temporary CEO appointments cannot be disseminated without verification as having occurred.
  • The information on changes, stock price fluctuations and recruitment budgets are at different levels and cannot be substituted for one another.
  • Job seekers applying for NVIDIA should focus on whether the position is valid, whether the interview continues, and whether the admission process changes.
  • OPT, STEM OPT and H-1B support needs to be identified by job and employment entity, and cannot be judged solely by company name.
  • Candidates who have entered the interview or obtained offer should retain written communications while continuing to advance other matching opportunities.

Where should we confirm the news of Wong In-hoon's resignation as Young Waida?

As at 2026-11-13, the relevant personnel changes and allegations of personal conduct and security concerns are not considered as verified facts. Involving changes in the leadership of listed companies, priority access NVIDIA Newsroom、NVIDIA Investor Relations and SEC EDGAR In company disclosure.

These links are official check points and do not mean that they have been published or confirmed. In so doing, a distinction needs to be made between the date of publication of the bulletin, the time of its entry into force and the formal appointment and provisional arrangements.

  • See the original announcement: Whether the outgoing post, the successor and the effective date are specified.
  • Watching regulatory disclosure: Existence of corresponding personnel change documents rather than only media titles.
  • Look at the attributions: The “Board discussion” “considering successors” and “appointment” is not the same conclusion.

Job seeking decisions need not wait for all disputes to be settled, but unconfirmed personnel information should be avoided as a basis for withdrawing an application.

Will changes in the CEOs lead to a freeze on recruitment?

The change in management itself does not support the freeze on recruitment. The team ' s headcount, project priorities and approval status is still to be confirmed, even if the handover is genuine, whether it affects a SDE, AI infrastructure or chip position.

Direct feedback at the post level is more useful to candidates than macro guesses. Yes. NVIDIA Careers Find the position and check the actual progress with recruiter.

Signals observedWhat can be judged on that?Suggested next steps
There are still jobs in the network of recruitersThe job is still on display and there is no guarantee that the budget will remain the same.Confirmation of continued acceptance
The interview was on schedule.The current recruitment process is still in progressAsk for follow-up arrangements and approval nodes
Postponement or suspension of interviewsChange in process for reasons to be confirmedAsk if it's scheduling or job adjustment.
Position down.Position is no longer publicly displayedConfirmation of full internal recruitment, cancellation or transfer
No, no, no, no.Recruitment pendingIdentification of remaining conditions and expected feedback time

It is not to be interpreted as a company-wide suspension of recruitment, or as a promise that jobs will be offered.

Shouldn't Chinese students now deliver NVIDIA?

If the job is matched, the entry is valid and the status of the person is allowed,We can continue delivery while we spread out target companies.I don't know. It is not necessary to abandon the application solely on the basis of management information, nor is it appropriate to place all job-seeking programmes in a single enterprise.

For candidates at different stages, different actions should be taken:

  • Ready for delivery: Adjusting the curriculum vitae around the job profile so that the project can experience the competencies required for the post.
  • Interviewing: Confirms whether the next round will proceed as usual and whether the functions and reporting lines will be adjusted.
  • Waiting for price: Ask if headcount has been approved and whether additional clearance is required.
  • Signed: Written confirmation of change in date of entry on duty, position and location, and maintenance of related mail.

When applying for an AI or a SDE post, the preparation should remain focused on an interpretable technical contribution: what problems have you solved, how you choose, and how you validate the results. Industry news can help understand business, but is not a substitute for project depth and interview preparation.

Will changes in the management of In Weida affect OPT or H1B support?

The change in OPT, STEM OPT or H1B policy cannot be inferred directly from CEO information. Nor is brand recognition at the company level a substitute for the actual support conditions of a post.

Immigration rules should be consulted USCIS ; personal status arrangements should be confirmed with DSO or qualified immigration counsel. The official link here is for the search rules, which do not represent a USCIS account of the company incident.

When communicating with recruiter, you can ask directly:

  • Does that post accept my current mandate?
  • Are there any arrangements for future H-1B candidates who need H-1B programme?
  • Will the employment entity, duty station or date of entry be adjusted?
  • Who handles identity-related materials?

For students who have been offered an offer, a distinction is made, in particular, between “recruit teams willing to recruit” and “identity-related processes have been completed” and not as a final result.

Common problems

Wong In-hoon has confirmed his resignation as the CEO?

This post cannot confirm the news. It should be based on verifiable NVIDIA official announcements and corresponding regulatory disclosures, and it is not appropriate to draw conclusions based solely on aggregate news titles.

Does the succession of Colette Kress mean that Yvette will cut recruitment?

Even if the succession was confirmed, the reduction in recruitment could not be inferred from it. The firm ' s clearly disclosed recruitment policy and feedback from specific teams need to be observed separately.

Young Waida is still on the line. Does that mean there must be a headcount?

Not necessarily. The open job page only indicates that the position is still on display and that the budget and approval status need to be confirmed to recruiter.

Should Chinese students be suspended from applying for Inweida?

Applications need not be suspended solely on the basis of unconfirmed personnel information. Continuing job matching while retaining interview opportunities in other companies is more conducive to managing job-seeking uncertainty.

We've got the offer. What do we need to reconfirm?

Priority is given to confirming the date of entry on duty, the retention of the post and the regularity of work authorizations and sponsorships; consultations with DSO or immigration lawyers are held promptly when personal status risks are involved.

wandover-b7d6d123991f5c08a9dbab84.body:
IBM Consulting reported that H-1B and career migrant green card guarantees would be discontinued for most United States positions; according to the internal arrangements relayed by the media, some of the affected employees would be required to: 2026 By the end ofChoose to transfer to an IBM overseas position or leave. For Chinese students who are applying for advisory positions, the key is not to directly exclude all IBM posts, but to confirm separately whether the targeted posts support OPT, follow-up H1B applications and the green card process, and not to substitute the company’s previous guaranteed record for current job commitments.

Key points

  • This change points to the majority of IBM Consulting positions in the United States, which cannot be extended directly to all IBM lines of operations for complete cessation of guarantees.
  • The adjustment relates to the H-1B and Green Card guarantees, which require confirmation from the company as to how the application is handled.
  • The number of reported global consultancies is not equal to the number of United States employees affected this time.
  • OPT Induction, H-1B Guarantee and PERM Support shall be separately questioned and obtain offer does not represent permanent identity support.

Which IBM posts will stop H-1B and green card guarantees?

As at 2026-11-12According to Siliconindia and its transposed Newsweek information, IBM spokespersons stated that as skills and customer demand changed, the company decided to stop providing visas and green card guarantees to most of the IBM Consulting positions.

There are three areas to be distinguished:

  • Scope of operations: IBM Consulting instead of automatically covering the entire IBM.
  • Scope of postMost of the posts in question, but not all of them, have been discontinued.
  • Scope: Affected employees relying on corporate guarantees, not all employees in the consulting sector.

The story says IBM Consulting employs more people worldwide. 150,000 peopleHowever, this figure cannot be considered as the number of people affected. The search for employment shall be based on the written response of the particular position, the employing entity and the recruiter.

Matters for verificationCurrent coverage informationWhat should we do when we find work?
H-1B GuaranteeMost U.S. consultancy posts will cease to supportAsk for initial application, employer change and extension support, respectively
Green card guaranteesAdjustment related to PERM processConfirm whether new processes are initiated and how existing processes are addressed
Staff movementPart of the staff may be transferred to an overseas post or separatedVerification of individual notifications, overseas positions and execution deadlines
Applicable sectorPointing to IBM ConsultingDo not apply conclusions to other business lines

What happens to employees who already have H-1B or are running green cards?

It was reported that affected employees who wished to continue to work in the United States needed to find new employers willing to provide corresponding guarantees.2026 The end of the year is the reported corporate arrangement node, not the cut-off date for immigration status that can be applied directly to everyone.

There is still uncertainty as to how the applications will be handled for employees who already hold H-1B and also process green cards through IBM. As soon as possible, HR and immigration lawyers should confirm:

  • The current H-1B validity period, the employment relationship and whether the company continues to support subsequent applications.
  • What stage is the PERM or other green card application at?
  • Whether overseas reassignments involve new contracts, duty stations and local work permits.
  • If other United States employers are selected, how should the application be connected?

See also USCIS Official H-1B Professional job descriptionsUnited States Department of Labor. PERM Project DescriptionI don't know. These official rules are used to understand the application mechanism and cannot be a substitute for IBM policy confirmation or individual legal opinions on specific employees.

How does an OPT student apply for a consultancy position determine whether the employer supports the guarantee?

The most likely miscalculation of job seekers who are still at the OPT stage is that the acceptance of the current work permit by the recruiter implies a willingness to provide H-1B and green card guarantees in the future. In practice, these are different recruitment and immigration support decisions that should be identified on a case-by-case basis.

It is suggested to ask directly at the recruiter screening stage:

  • "Is this specific post open to OPT candidates?"
  • “Does the post support the H-1B future need?”
  • “Does the policy vary according to line of operations, client projects or duty station?”
  • “Does the company support the start-up of the post, does it have internal conditions?”

Upon receipt of an oral reply, an understanding can be confirmed by mail and a job description and communication record maintained. The need for future guarantees should not be concealed, nor should staff sharing, historical approval records or third-party databases be used as job commitments.

For advisory, technical advisory and related positions, it is recommended that:Job matching and identity support feasibility are included in the delivery screening SelectI don't know. Even if the technology stack and the project experience are highly compatible, if the post does not support the security required, priority should be adjusted in a timely manner, rather than waiting until the infer phase to find the path incompatible.

Common problems

Is the IBM completely out of school for H1B?

This cannot be summed up. This report points to the existence of different arrangements for most of the IBM Consulting positions in the United States, with specific lines of operation and positions to be confirmed to the recruiter.

Getting an IBM OPT offer means you can handle H-1B later?

Doesn't mean. Acceptance of OPT entry on duty and support for subsequent H-1B applications are different matters and should be verified separately before acceptance of offer.

Would IBM stop the green card guarantee and automatically invalidate the current application?

It cannot be based solely on corporate policy reporting. The follow-up of existing applications depends on the application stage, company action and personal circumstances, and should be assessed by the counsel in charge of the case.

Was the end of 2026 the legal deadline for all affected employees to stay?

Nope. The end-of-year arrangements in the report are company-level nodes of destination, and individual identities and work authorization periods require separate confirmation.

wandover-f2f54ddc4ecb7639341b98c8.dek: AI's investment has increased dramatically, while recruitment has shrunk. It is for the students to understand the changes in budget flows and job thresholds.
wandover-f2f54ddc4ecb7639341b98c8.body:
According to The Cool Down, Meta cuts 8000 postsand cancel 6000 planned recruitment positions, while promoting large-scale AI infrastructure inputs. In the case of Chinese students in North America, there is no doubt that this is the case.AI Increased input is not equal to increased recruitmentWhen applying for a post in Meta, AI or SDE, priority should be given to confirming whether the post is still approved, whether the team continues to recruit, and whether it supports its own work mandate.

Key points

  • Some 8000 posts were dismissed and 6000 recruitment plans were cancelled.
  • Increased expenditure on infrastructure, such as data centres and GPUs, would not represent the same proportion of the budget for recruitment.
  • AI teams may also be abolished and reorganized, and having the name AI does not mean more stable.
  • The status of the position, the team needs and OPT/H1B support should be identified separately prior to the delivery of the student to avoid treating process start-up as an employment guarantee.

What difference does it make when Meta downsized 8,000 people and cancelled 6,000 recruitment plans?

Retrenchment affects existing posts, and the abolition of recruitment means that the planned opportunities for new or additional posts are not advanced. Both would compress the job opening space, but could not be confused with the same downsizing data.

The following figures are from The Cool Down.2026-11-10 is the time point for the job search observation.

MattersNumbers reportedHow do you understand when looking for a job?
Reduction of existing postsAbout 800Some teams are downsizing.
Cancel planned recruitment6000 postsThe original recruitment opportunities may no longer be open
AI Infrastructure inputsHighest $1350 billionIt can't be directly translated into a recruitment budget.
Capital expenditure in 2026135 billion to 145 billion dollarsThe Cool Down transposes the capital expenditure calibration of Reuters

According to Startup Fortune, support functions and non-AI product teams are heavily affected, and some integrity and cybersecurity teams are also involved in adjustments. When applying for these directions, the specific team needs to be identified, not based solely on Meta ' s corporate recruitment page.

  • The position is still on line.: Not equal to the active promotion of recruitment of officers.
  • Get the ink.• Not equal to the number of posts still approved.
  • Access to interviewsFollow-up on the suspension or adjustment of posts is still required.

Why isn't Meta's AI input equal to the AI job offer?

AI infrastructure budget is mainly for assets such as data centres, GPU, and is not equivalent to staff remuneration and new headcount.Infrastructure expansion, internal transfers and external recruitment can change in different directions.

The $135.0 billion and $13.5 billion to $14.5 billion should also not be used interchangeably: the former is a narrative for reporting AI infrastructure inputs, and the latter is the 2026 capital expenditure zone that it transferred to Reuters. Capital expenditures are of a broader financial calibre and cannot be fully understood as funds for the recruitment of AI engineers.

It was also mentioned that Meta had also abolished the AI team while moving existing staff to AI-related positions. Therefore, screening opportunities should be based on actual work:

  • Infrastructure posts: Does it involve distributed systems, calculation of resource efficiency or reliability of the production environment?
  • Applied posts: Does it serve a clear product demand rather than a broad AI label?
  • Research and experimental posts: Is the team goal, reporting lines and resource allocation clear?

Available when reconciling the company ' s latest disclosures Meta Investor Relations Financial reports and announcements; position-specific status should be based on the current response of the recruitment team.

What should be confirmed before students apply for the positions of Meta, SDE and AI?

Rexpand suggests that the order of the screening be changed to:Verification of opportunities, matching of capabilities and eventual high-cost preparation. Company brands can help to establish target lists, but they cannot be a substitute for judging specific jobs.

When communicating with repruiter or Hiring Manager, you can ask:

  • Recruitment places: Does this request still receive approval and does the interview continue?
  • Nature of post: Is it a new post, a replacement job, or an internal reorganization?
  • Team requirements: What are the main responsibilities on entry and what are the immediate delivery targets?
  • Task authorization: Does the post accept its own OPT status, and does it consider follow-up H-1B post?

The company ' s past support for H1B is not understood as support for all teams and positions. OPT and H-1B eligibility, application and identity requirements shall be USCIS Network of Officials The applicable provisions are the same; personal circumstances may be confirmed by the school DSO or qualified immigration lawyer.

Delivery strategies should also be spread across companies and business lines. The curriculum vitae focuses on explaining clear project contributions, technical decision-making and operational values, rather than rewriting them as experiences they cannot prove in interviews in pursuit of AI.

Common problems

Does Meta have 14,000 laid-offs this time?

Nope. Some 800 were reported to have been laid off and another 6000 were scheduled for cancellation, which could not be combined into the number of staff reductions.

Does it mean that AI posts are easier to get offer?

That can't be inferred. Infrastructure inputs are mainly related to data centres and computing resources, and external recruitment is also dependent on team budgets, job clearance and matching of candidates.

We've got a meta push. Do we need to confirm position?

Need. Intropolation facilitated access to the recruitment process but did not guarantee the continued validity of recruitment quotas, and it was recommended that progress should continue to be verified with recruiter.

Will Meta layoffs directly change OPT or H1B rules?

Company layoffs do not change immigration rules on their own, but an individual ' s loss of employment may affect his/her status arrangements; the applicable requirements should be confirmed promptly to DSO or immigration lawyers.

wandover-2eeb84fa4e686aececaedc50.dek: From private relations disputes to board investigations, how does the risk of key figures in Weida reach AI?
wandover-2eeb84fa4e686aececaedc50.body:
Anecdotals from the CEO survey in Weida do not amount to a cooling down of AI recruitment: the information provided does not confirm that Yveida has frozen recruitment, laid off staff or abolished jobs, nor is it sufficient to judge changes in employment demand across the AI industry. As of the date of this document, the relevant investigation claims still need to be cross-checked with official information; for North American Chinese students, it would be more useful to confirm whether the targeted positions are open, teams are approved for recruitment and work visas are supported.

Key points

  • The TechCrunch text provided relates to the statement of the investigation, but the absence of a fully verifiable date of publication and corresponding official communiqué cannot be considered as having been established.
  • The scholars' judgement of CEO's departure was personal, not a finding, nor an AI recruitment forecast.
  • This submission does not provide data on the number of jobs, recruitment budgets or offer withdrawals, which would make it impossible to assert that the job market is cold.
  • Job seekers should, as a matter of priority, verify the network of corporate recruiters, feedback from recruiters and the actual needs of the team, rather than suspending delivery solely on the basis of press titles.

What information remains to be verified from the investigation of the CEO of In Weida?

TechCrunch's extract from this submission states that the British Board of Directors initiated an independent investigation and cited scholars to discuss management stability. However, since the text was cut off at the end and the material was not accompanied by an investigation document corresponding to the Board ' s bulletin or independently verifiable, the allegations relating to the conduct of individuals and national security are not reproduced as established facts.

Other sources also needed to distinguish between the fact that the press summary attributed the FBI investigation narrative to Reuters, but did not provide the original version; and that the Bloomberg link captured access to the validation page, which did not confirm its specific coverage.

Information in MaterialsCurrent evidence boundaryCan you judge the change in recruitment against this?
Board survey in TechCrunch textNeed to check the original language, date of publication and official responseI can't.
The summary of the FBI investigation attributed to Reuters.No corresponding language provided, pending validationI can't.
Scholars' judgement of CEO riskIt's personal, not statistical.I can't.
The industry risk story from Bloomberg.Ripping content to authenticate page, text not availableI can't.
Retrenchment, recruitment freeze or offer adjustmentNo data provided in this submissionNo basis for conclusion

When checking, give priority to viewingNetwork of Investors of EnglandA company announcement and regulatory documents are in place. The portal is a follow-up verification channel and does not mean that official documents supporting these rumours have been found.

Will the governance risks in England affect AI's employment prospects?

Governance risks may affect enterprise decision-making, but “may affect” is not equivalent to “has affected recruitment”. If management uncertainty further alters project approval, client procurement or financing arrangements, the team ' s plans for expansion may be channelled; this is a risk analysis and is not the result of the confirmation of this material.

For job seekers, the following signals need to be observed separately:

  • At the corporate level: Formal alignment of business expectations, project inputs or personnel plans.
  • Team level: Whether the hiring manager confirms that there is a budget for the job and whether the interview continues.
  • Position level: Changes in duties, duty stations, recruitment priorities and entry arrangements.
  • At the sectoral level: Whether there has been a continuous and verifiable change in demand by different employers rather than pushing individual company disputes out of the market as a whole.

AI chips, cloud infrastructure, modelling and application software are not the same recruitment market. The employment prospects of AI should be judged in terms of the needs and budgets of the specific business, and not only in terms of British share price or CEO-related news.

Should North American students now vote for British Vader and AI?

If the position is still open and skill matching, there is no need to stop the application simply because of an insufficiently verified rumour. However, it is not appropriate to place a job search plan on a single company or a single track.

It is suggested that the following order be followed:

  • Check positions: Present.NVIDIA CareersThe status of the posts is confirmed and links, duties and placements are recorded; there are still posts in the network that do not necessarily represent recruitment.
  • Confirmation of recruitment progress: Whether the communications function with Recruiter is still moving forward, whether there is a change in team requirements and whether there are clear next steps.
  • A visa advance: Direct recognition of OPT, STEM OPT or H-1B support for specific positions and personal circumstances does not take company past practice as a current commitment.
  • Divisiond delivery: Attention is also given to SDE, data analysis, data science and infrastructure jobs where skills can be migrated, reducing the impact of changes in individual company decision-making.

Work visas and status determinationUSCIS Network of OfficialsThis document does not provide a case-by-case immigration legal opinion. Prior to adjusting the job-seeking strategy, you have to confirm your time constraints before you decide to place them on a priority basis.

Common problems

Have you announced a freeze on recruitment?

This submission does not contain a call for a freeze on recruitment. It is therefore not possible to draw the conclusion from this news that “Inveda has stopped recruiting”.

Can the CEO “Five-Five” job risk be used as a basis for forecasting?

Can't. The text provided attributed this statement to the scholars interviewed, which was a personal judgement and not a corporate announcement, findings or probabilities model that could be used for recruitment decisions.

We're already in the Inverda interview process. Do we need to quit?

There is no need to withdraw on hearsay alone. It would be more prudent to continue to prepare while at the same time confirming to the recruit the position and retaining the interview opportunities of other companies.

Does the risk of investment in the AI industry mean that there should be no more AI jobs?

Doesn't mean. Investment risks are not equivalent to specific job requirements and should be judged in conjunction with team operations, skills matching and recruitment progress, rather than in general abandoning the entire industry.

Should students be concerned about corporate news or visa support?

Both are seen, but whether the job is actually advanced and whether the personal status conditions are matched directly affects the decision to find a job; identification arrangements should be verified with the relevant office of the school or qualified lawyer.

wandover-3236f6beb91e4f5241a53d5a.dek: Astro only sells thousands. Why is Amazon recruiting robots? This time it's worth watching, not just algorithmic.
wandover-3236f6beb91e4f5241a53d5a.body:
Amazon is recruiting new family robots, and North American Chinese students can be of concern, but it cannot be judged at this point that companies are expanding on a large scale. According to FourWeekMBA 8 November 2026Published and retransmitted reports from the CNBC investigation, the leads include Fauna ' s on-site support engineers and senior UX design positions; whether the specific position remains open, and whether or not to accept your work mandate needs to be verified individually by Amazon Jobs.

Key points

  • The new recruitment movement in Amazonia points to consumer-grade family robots and should not be confused with storage robot posts.
  • The official posts cited in the report include Field Support Engineering and Prince UX Designer, which cannot be used to extrapolate all software or product positions.
  • No new product names, sales prices, listing dates or team sizes were reported.
  • North American students should, as a matter of priority, check their status, grade, skill requirements and work authorization conditions before deciding whether to apply.
  • The growth in robotic financing is an industry context and does not equate to an increase in Amazon jobs, nor does it mean that job-seekers are more easily available.

What job was the Amazon family robot team in 2026?

According to FourWeekMBA, 8 November 2026.Through recruitment information, CNBC found that a new family robot team had been formed in Amazon and that new robotic products were being recruited.

The report also states that the Amazon March 2026Purchase of Fauna Robotics and plans to include it in the personal Robotics Group. For job seekers, it is more worth tracking specific job responsibilities than just team names.

Job or recruitment trailInformation provided in the reportWhat should be verified prior to the application

Principal UX DesignerDefines how people live and interact with Fauna robots.Level, portfolio requirements, interactive design experience
Engineer position withdrawnUsed to describe navigational, autonomous products in a dynamic family environmentNo posts should be still available

This post is based on Amazon Jobs' official page quoted in the report:Field Support Engineer、Principal UX DesignerI don't know. The job opening and application requirements should be based on the Amazon Jobs page.

Is robotic software, UX, and product direction worth voting for?

It is interesting to note, however, that a distinction should be made between “relevant competencies may be useful” and “opt-out positions”. The posts mentioned in the report cover on-site engineering and UX; students looking for suitable software, products or algorithms are given further access to official recruitment pages to screen jobs that are compatible with their experience.

It is recommended that the screening be based on capability, rather than searching only for robots:

  • Engineering and software orientationSearch for keywords such as robotics, Software Development and Autonomy, and check whether the function involves robotic systems.
  • UX orientationFocus on human interaction with physical equipment, unusual feedback, experience design requirements in a family environment.
  • Field support direction• Read the functions of troubleshooting, customer communication, deployment support, etc., and do not interpret them directly as purely software development.
  • Product orientation: Job alerts can be set, but project start-up cannot be considered as an existing product manager.

In preparing the project experience, an explanation should be provided of the problems, how the results were validated and the constraints encountered. There is no experience with robotic hardware, nor is it appropriate to package ordinary software projects into robotic landing experience.

Does the reactivation of family robots in Amazon mean a massive surge?

Doesn't mean. The reports did not give the number of teams, the total number of recruitments or the number of places to be filled, nor did they disclose the timing of the listing of new products.

According to the report, the CNBC information that used to be used by Astro in Amazonia is now in the 2021Despite the fact that household products reach only thousands of customers. The new project demonstrates that the company is still exploring family robots and does not represent a mature business model for consumer products.

The same is true for financing data:

IndicatorsData reportedI can't push it out.
The year 2025 robots and physical AI financing$28.7 billionNot a single area of financing for family robots
Same-calibre financing in the first half of 2026$33.4 billionNot representative of Amazon recruitment budget or number of posts

These figures are from November 8, 2026.Inflows of industry funds could serve as an observation point and could not be a substitute for job verification.

What do you want to verify before applying for a student stay in North America?

It is recommended that the post be redeployed and the curriculum vitae adjusted. In particular, it is important to avoid mixing storage automation positions in Amazon Robotics' search results with the Fauna Home Robotics Project.

  • Check TeamSee if the body of the position explicitly refers to Fauna, Personal Robotics, or to home use.
  • Check threshold:: Distinguishing between senior grades such as Princeal and posts suitable for their own experience, without neglecting requirements because of company names.
  • Check Status: Enter the application process from the Amazon Jobs official page, and the position has been withdrawn only for research capacity needs.
  • Checking delegation of authorityChecking the position and related issues on the application form; individual judgements concerning OPT, STEM OPT or H-1B should be confirmed by the school DSO or qualified immigration lawyer.

The name of the job does not in itself prove that the employer provides work visa support, nor does the current press describe the sponsorship policy for these positions.

Common problems

Is the Amazon family robot team still recruiting?

The report of 8 November 2026 provided a recruitment trail, but there was no guarantee that the positions would remain open thereafter. Please check the Amazon Jobs page and application portal before applying.

Without a robotic background, can you apply for a job?

wandover-d2ab0dd3faf93e8537ea615d.title: Congress is changing! How good are the students waiting?
wandover-d2ab0dd3faf93e8537ea615d.dek: The Democrats take down two houses. Will H-1B, OPT change? Political transition and job opportunities are still at a few points in the way.
wandover-d2ab0dd3faf93e8537ea615d.body:
The mid-term elections in the United States did not amount to an immediate easing of H1B, OPT or F-1 policies, and students should not adjust their status arrangements solely on the basis of election news. The reproducing article states that the Democrats won both houses of Congress, but this document does not independently verify this result; it concerns the authorization of work, the eligibility to apply and the time of entry into force, subject to the official announcement and the applicable legal documents.

Key points

  • The original formulation of the election results and policy shifts cannot be considered directly as verified policy facts.
  • Even if congressional control changes, the H-1B, OPT and F-1 rules are not automatically revoked, restored or modified.
  • The original references to “H-1B-weighted options have been implemented” and “D/S needs to be reinstated” require separate verification of official documents.
  • The job search of a student must be accompanied by a confirmation of job needs, a guarantee of the employer ' s will and an individual ' s work authorization.

Can the results of the mid-term elections in the United States be directly considered as a student retention policy?

Can't. The results of the elections, policy projections and the provisions in force are information at different levels.

The tweets cited the “Democrats take over both houses” as a prerequisite for subsequent analysis and referred to media reports such as Reuters and BBC, but did not provide a cross-checkable link to the corresponding reports. There is also an inconsistency in the article ' s description of the age of political change in Texas, and it is therefore not appropriate to rephrase it directly as an official network to confirm news.

This paper uses 6 November 2026 as the time frame for editing and does not draw conclusions on the attribution of seats that have not been independently verified. Readers can readUnited States House of Representatives official election statistics portalThe results are verified by the state electoral authorities; there may be a time lag in the publication of official statistics.

When reading such news, it is recommended to confirm:

  • At the electoral level:Media forecasts, counting results, or state-level certifications?
  • Policy level:Is it a statement by a congressman, a bill proposal, or a formal rule?
  • Implementation level:Does it specify the time of entry into force, the persons to whom it applies and the transitional arrangements?

Political checks and balances may influence policy discussions, but may not directly introduce “safer student status” or “work visa availability”.

Will changes in Congress automatically lift H-1B restrictions and relax OPT?

It won't happen automatically. The legislative acts of the National Assembly, the rules of the executive branch and the decisions of the courts are different mechanisms and cannot be replaced by electoral victories.

The story in the news.Direct basis for actionContent to be verified
H1B restrictions will be reducedNo, it's just policy expectations.Progress of the bill, formal rules and persons to whom it applies
H-1B weighted selection is cancelledYou can't assume the rule state.USCIS bulletin and corresponding rule text
OPT won't be canceled.Not as a guarantee.Work authorization requirements and subsequent rule changes
The D/S system for the F-1 will be restoredI can't assume it's been canceled.DHS official documents, entry into force arrangements and judicial implications

This is especially important.The original phrase “the abolition of OPT requires the adoption of legislation” should not be interpreted as implying that OPT can only be adjusted through Congress legislation. The legal path for specific changes needs to be judged in conjunction with the basis for delegation of authority, administrative procedures and judicial review.

Authoritative check-ins include:

  • USCIS：H-1B Specialty Occupations
  • USCIS：OPT for F-1 Students
  • Federal Regulation Inquiry
  • Congress.gov: Congressional Bill Inquiry

The above is the official verification portal and does not mean that the present document has verified all its updates as at 6 November 2026. The date of issuance and the date of entry into force of the document should be recorded when specific policies were invoked, rather than retaining only the press title.

What should be the way for students to work and to plan their status?

Prioritize identifiable work authorizations and employer requirements, and view policy improvements as uncertainties. For students in North America staying in China, the availability of interviews and the support of employers for long-term status arrangements require separate confirmation.

During the delivery and interview phases, records can be built around the following issues:

  • Are candidates for OPT positions accepted?
  • Is the company considering the future of H-1B sponsorship?
  • Do guarantee arrangements vary according to job, team or recruitment batch?
  • Is the entry period linked to the individual ' s work authorization?
  • Can recruitment instructions be further confirmed through written communication?

Rather than relying solely on a “work visa previously held by the company” to judge that the current position must be guaranteed, the initial response of the recruiter should not be regarded as a legal commitment.

Identity-related arrangements should be checked with the school DSO and qualified immigration lawyers; professional preparation can continue to advance curriculum vitae, project expression, job matching and interview training. Rexpand offers an open-ended class of 1v1 business mentors and interview products to help job-seekers to improve their professional preparation, but does not replace immigration legal services, nor does it guarantee offer or visa outcomes.

Common problems

If the Democrats win Congress, will the H1B signature rate rise?

This cannot be judged. The results of the elections themselves were not sufficient to extrapolate the H-1B draw rate or the probability of selection, and the specific mechanisms and application requirements required verification of official rules.

Can you postpone looking for a job?

Not recommended. Policy projections are not a substitute for individual work authorization requirements. They should be based on their actual time frames and check identity matters with DSO.

Has H-1B weighting been implemented?

This is expressed in the articles provided, but this paper does not independently verify the status of its rules. Please see the specific documents of USCIS and Federal Register, distinguishing between proposed, final publication and actual entry into force.

Is the F-1 visa one thing, the American identity and the work authorization?

No, there is no substitute for judgement. In the case of travel, entry, study or organization of work, the applicable requirements shall be verified separately and the DSO or immigration lawyer shall be consulted as necessary.

Is this an immigration legal opinion?

Can't. This document is used for information analysis and job search planning purposes, and individual status decisions are based on official documents and the opinions of qualified professionals.

wandover-2df0e6013c558f4b85f190a6.title: I'm up to $1.45 million. What do you want to follow?
wandover-2df0e6013c558f4b85f190a6.dek: It's not a model that is worth a lot of money. Open a total of $1.45 million to understand the ability of AI to actually pay for the job.
wandover-2df0e6013c558f4b85f190a6.body:
The USA deployment of engineers of up to $1.45 million refers to the total annual remuneration of the senior “elite” and includes basic salaries, bonuses and annualized equity, rather than the initial salary. ZDNET repeats the recruitment agency Christian & The Tibers study shows that businesses are willing to pay high salaries for engineers who can access AI, complete deployment and prove ROI; it is these competency requirements that are more worth drawing on for students in North America than to apply the pay ceiling directly.

Key points

  • The study estimates that the total annual remuneration of the “elite” AI deployed engineers is $586,000-1.45 million, with senior leaders up to $2.25 million.
  • The study was based on more than 550 interviews from January to June 2026, as well as on a closed and still open offer, where pay ranges were not statistical averages.
  • The “elite” FDE in the study usually has 7 to 15 years of experience and does not represent regular AI posts or leave students for graduation.
  • AI applications for deployment, system integration, client delivery and measurable operational results are the direction of high-value capabilities that this coverage represents.
  • The job search must be accompanied by a check of job duties, remuneration composition and visa support, and the opportunity cannot be judged by the FDE job name alone.

Is it true that USAI deployed engineers with $1.45 million a year?

The report does give a ceiling of $1.45 million, but it is an estimate of the total remuneration of a particular senior population, not an industry-wide average wage. Christian & Tibers is a senior recruitment and leadership advisory body, whose research sample includes engineers, deployment managers and corporate executives.

As of 5 November 2026, this document is organized on the basis of the ZDNET reports provided; the date of publication is not indicated. The following figures are taken from ZDNET ' s repertoire of the Institute ' s research and are not government wage statistics or official enterprise wage commitments.

Reporting indicatorsValueCorrect.
Annual gross remuneration of “Fair” AI deployed engineersUS$ 58.66 million - US$ 1.45 millionIncluding basic wages, bonuses and annualized equity
Maximum gross salary of senior deployment leader$2.25 millionIt's higher up. It can't be used with ordinary engineers.
Senior Engineer Award and share52%—66%Total remuneration does not equal fixed cash income
Study interview scaleMore than 550 timesForming estimation ranges in conjunction with offer, not statistical averages
Size of the most senior United States deployment leaderAbout 2,000 peopleThe estimates previously studied by the Agency do not represent all AI engineers.

When comparing offer, the basic salary, the conditions of the bonus, the equity attribution arrangement and the valuation calibre should be viewed separately. The wage range in the job advertisements does not necessarily include the full equity and bonus value discussed in the report.

Source:ZDNET, repeat Christian. & Timbers Research。

What more valuable capabilities do AI need to deploy engineers and FDE?

It's not about using the AI tool, it's about using it.Deployment of the AI system to the enterprise environment and accountability for operational resultsI don't know. Forward Defense Engineer, the “prime” of the study, usually has 7-15 years of experience, of which at least two years are devoted to the construction and deployment of automated workflows.

The agency is also defined as having an enterprise impact of at least $10 million that can be recorded and leading other deployed engineers. This is a condition for the selection of high-level talent for the study and should not be understood as a uniform threshold for recruitment for all BDEs.

For students to stay, this signal can be translated into the following orientations for capacity-building; these are job offers, not pay guarantees from the study:

  • Application deployment: It is not only a demonstration of model outputs but also an indication of how the service works, how it is monitored, and how it is handled when it fails.
  • System integration: It explains how AI connects existing data, API and business processes, and how authority and data boundaries are managed.
  • Client delivery: Fuzzy demands can be translated into acceptance standards and communication with business parties on constraints, risks and delivery ranges.
  • Impact assessment: The quality of outputs, costs, delays and operational benefits are considered at the same time, rather than showing only success stories.

The collection need not claim to produce substantial commercial value, but must distinguish between real results, test results and expected benefits. When there is no business deployment experience, the experimental environment and limitations are clearly explained and more credible than packaging them as “production level projects”.

How do students look for AI applications deployment and client assignments?

Search on duty is more effective than searching only for “AI deployed engineers”. The report warns that similar jobs may be distributed under different job titles; publicly recruited FDE positions also cover a wider range of experience and responsibilities.

Key words of concern in English include:

  • Forward Deployment Engineer / FDE
  • AI Solutions Engineer
  • Senior Principal AI Engineer
  • Staff Software Engineer / Principal AI Engineer

Some of these positions are clearly senior and it is not appropriate to see the AI keyword as being suitable for the next grade. The selection of JDs should focus on the length of service, independent delivery responsibilities, client communication requirements and whether it involves the maintenance of the production environment.

In preparing curricula vitae and interviews, project evidence can be organized on the basis of “operational issues—technical programmes—demonstration of the deployment process—proves” and offers its contribution. If a United States work visa is involved, the employer ' s identity requirements and support policy will also have to be independently verified;This study does not prove that the posts in question support OPT, STEM OPT or H-1B.

Common problems

Is $1.45 million in basic salaries for AI deployment engineers?

Nope. The $1.45 million reported is the annual gross remuneration ceiling, which includes basic wages, bonuses and annualized equity.

Without years of experience, can a student apply for a FDE?

It can be judged by specific JDs, but not by the definition of “eliminator” in the study as a requirement for all FDE posts. Priority is given to identifying opportunities for deployment, integration and delivery of applications that match their own contexts.

Does AI deploy engineers have to do modeling?

Not necessarily. The report focuses on AI landing capability and job readiness cannot be limited to model training or calling API, but should also cover deployment, assessment and business communication.

Can this study represent the average salary of AI in 2026?

Can't. The study gives estimates for specific categories of talent rather than statistical average wages for all AI positions in the United States.

wandover-29d6141d856ec33df36a0f71.title: What should students be warned about when the United States lost more than 150,000 in October?
wandover-29d6141d856ec33df36a0f71.dek: AI has been named to be associated with more than 31,000 lay-offs, but the real impact is not just on the number of jobs.
wandover-29d6141d856ec33df36a0f71.body:
United States companies announced 153,074 layoffs in October, but this does not mean that all companies will stop recruiting, nor can it be a direct extrapolation of the probability that Chinese students will get a offer. According to the Startup Fortune report provided, it cites Challenger, Gray & According to Christmas, this is the highest total of staff reductions announced in October since 2003. For students left behind, the more practical response would be to verify whether jobs were still approved, confirm the employer ' s work authorization requirements and adjust the delivery and interview preparation.

Key points

  • The United States employer announced 153,074 staff reductions in October, an increase of 175 per cent over the same period. The statistical calculator is “declared layoffs”, not the actual number of unemployed in the month.
  • The science and technology industry announced a reduction of 33,281 personnel in October, but the total number of jobs does not indicate a change in recruitment and internships for each company.
  • The employer attributed 31,039 redundancies to AI, but this did not constitute an independent validation of the process whereby AI replaced each post.
  • Student retention should require screening opportunities in the context of recruitment status, team budgets and job authorizations, and not simply on the basis of the title of redundancy.

What does the October 2026 United States cut-off figure mean?

According to Chartup Fortune, the number of staff reductions announced by United States employers in October was 153,074, compared to 55,597 during the same period of the previous year, an increase of 175 per cent over the same period. The report describes it as the highest October total since 2003.Not the highest record in all months.。

IndicatorsReporting dataHow do you understand when looking for a job?
Total staff reductions announced in October153,074Reflects the downsizing plans announced by the enterprise
Total number of staff reductions announced in October of the previous year55,597For comparison
Reductions related to cost reductions50,437 personsReasons for redundancy declared by the employer
AI-related adjustments and reductions31,039It's not the same as all the layoffs were caused by AI.
The storage industry announced layoffs.47,878 personsIndustry risks cannot be applied directly to all office positions
Science and technology industry announced layoffs.33,281 personsSpecific companies and teams still need to be consulted

Source and verification instructions:As at 2026-11-04, this document is based on user-provided data Startup Fortune Report;the original statistical agency is Challenger, Gray & Christmas, not the United States government department. The material provided does not contain links to the original report and the date of publication, and therefore the second-hand reference sign is retained here and is not packaged as independently validated official data.

To read this set of figures, it is necessary to distinguish between:

  • Declared cuts and actual separations:The duration of implementation may vary and cannot be considered directly as the number of new unemployed persons during the month.
  • Retrenchment and recruitment:Enterprises may cut some of their operations while retaining the recruitment of other teams.
  • One-month comparison against long-term trends:The dramatic increase in the one-month period was alarming, but was not sufficient to demonstrate alone that future recruitment would continue to contract.

Can tech companies and AI-related staff cuts affect student retention?

Such changes may affect recruitment budgets, job requirements and the transfer of internships, but reports do not provide for student retention, retention or international student admission rates. Thus, it cannot be asserted that “students' posts have been reduced by a certain percentage”.

The number of staff reductions related to AI reflects thatClassification of reasons for employer declarationsThis is not an independent cause-effect study. For job-seekers such as SDE, DA, DS, it would be more useful to check whether the mandate of the targeted post has changed, rather than merely determine whether the job name is “safe”.

  • Look at JD:Distinction between duties that require operational judgement, system design and data validation.
  • Look at the items:Cases prepared to explain problem definitions, technical options and validation of results.
  • Watch the team:To understand the product, client and business needs of job-based services and to avoid relying solely on corporate brand names to judge stability.
  • Internship:Confirmation to recruiters of the transition to the assessment process and the post budget does not take oral expectations as a guarantee.

The use of an AI tool could be part of the competency demonstration, but it could not replace the professional base and did not mean avoiding the risk of redundancy.

How do students now adjust America's job-seeking strategy?

It is proposed to replace the words “by mass on company lists” with the words “by job effectiveness”. The redundancies provide a risk signal; whether or not it is worth the preparation time and requires information at the job level.

Before delivery, verify the following:

  • Whether the network of company officials remains open and whether the location and duties of the position are clear.
  • Whether the recruiter can confirm that the position is still moving forward, rather than simply collecting the curriculum vitae.
  • JD and the recruiters' demands on OPT, STEM OPT and future H-1B sponsorship are consistent.
  • Whether the target team has been affected by the restructuring and whether the interview process has changed.

After the interview, the preparation is centralized into verifiable evidence:

  • The project describes the personal contribution and does not attribute all team results to itself.
  • Displays how to check AI output, process errors and protect data.
  • Alumni exchange or introspection, but does not equate introspection with recruitment commitments.
  • At the same time, other opportunities are being followed to avoid placing the entire job search schedule on a positive or offer that has not yet been confirmed.

If the downsizing has affected the individual ' s working arrangements, the status should be based on USCIS official guidelinesThis document does not provide a case-by-case migration law judgement.

Common problems

Did the United States, with 153,074 layoffs in October, represent the same number of people who lost their jobs that month?

Nope. Statistics are provided on the announced lay-offs by employers and cannot be directly equated with actual departures or new unemployment during the month.

Is this the highest one-month reduction since 2003?

Not that. The report refers to the highest total of “October” announced reductions since 2003, rather than the record for all months.

Are STDs worth applying for SDE or data jobs after their cuts?

Applications may be continued, but the recruitment status of specific teams and the requirement for job authorization should be verified. The figures on layoffs are not sufficient to determine whether a given post still has a budget.

Does AI-related redundancy mean that students must be transferred?

It cannot be concluded on that basis. A more rational adjustment would be to strengthen the operational understanding, professional base and AI results validation capacity, before deciding whether to switch to the target job requirements.

wandover-49378de2c0eca25bfdd7a0ae.title: Thirty-five percent of New York, Texas, California. Should the students vote?
wandover-49378de2c0eca25bfdd7a0ae.dek: Green card applications are concentrated and do not amount to H1B being better collected. Before choosing a state, understand the boundaries of this data.
wandover-49378de2c0eca25bfdd7a0ae.body:
California, Texas and New York are markets of interest for Chinese students to screen for United States job-seeking areas, but active green card applications do not make it easier to obtain H1B or green cards locally. According to USCIS data transmitted by The American Bazaar on 22 October 2026, the three cantons together account for 35 per cent of the I-140 applications and approved activities of occupational migrants in the third quarter of the 2026 fiscal year; this data does not support the individual ranking of the cantons and is not used to calculate the probability of individual approvals.

Key points

  • Statistics cover the period from 1 April to 30 June 2026 and are not for the entire year 2026 or for real-time data as of November.
  • California, Texas and New York combined accounted for 35 per cent, and the original text did not provide independent data sufficient to confirm the precise ranking of the states.
  • I-140 Approval is a different step from eventual acquisition of a green card, and quarterly approvals cannot be used as green card issuances.
  • Job seekers in the Länder should look at job matching, employer guarantee policy and cost of living at the same time, and not only at immigration applications.

What does the 2026 Green Card application data say?

The American Bazaar, in a report dated 22 October 2026, cited the Financial Express compilation of USCIS data, stating that the three cantons were an important centre for application activities for occupational migrants.This data is derived from a recitation of the report and is not an independently validated USCIS State raw form.

The national data presented in the report are as follows, covering the third quarter of fiscal year 2026, from 1 April to 30 June 2026:

IndicatorsNational dataHow should I understand?
I-140 Incoming62,932 copiesApplications received during the period were not approved
I-140 Ratifications37,975Applications approved during the season, probably from the previous quarter
I-140 Rejection7,069 copiesThe decision to refuse was made during the season.
Trials at the end of the season203,204 copiesPending stock as at 30 June 2026
California, Texas, New York.35%Proportion of reported applications and approved activities, not individual success rates

These figures cannot be directly dissociated from the “success rate of applications for the current quarter” nor can the additional backlog be calculated by subtracting the amount received from the approvals. The receipt does not necessarily correspond to the processing of the same applications.

Similarly, the word “leading” in the title of the news cannot be replaced by “California fixes First, Second, Second, Third in New York”. It is clear from the original text: confirmation of the number of states and their ranking on the docket requires further examination of the USCIS State Table.

Is it more likely that H1B and Green Cards will find jobs in the Green Card state?

The concentration of applications for occupational migration can serve as a clue to finding an employer, but the H1B guarantee cannot be directly introduced with more opportunities, much less with higher drawing of lots.The report counted I-140 instead of H-1B registration, drawing of lots or approval of data.

I-140 is usually submitted by United States employers for foreign employees; partially eligible applicants may also apply on their own initiative. Therefore, the heat of applications at the state level does not all correspond to the enterprise ' s recruitment needs.

For Chinese students, it is more useful to verify the targeted employers on a case-by-case basis:

  • Do you accept your position as authorized? “Acceptance of OPT” is not to be understood as a promise of subsequent guarantees.
  • Does the company support H1B? Subject to recruitment requirements and clear response from the recruitment team.
  • Are career migration processes supported? Ask about the conditions for start-up, internal policy and applicable posts.
  • Is the policy applicable to current positions? In the past, the company had secured records, which did not mean that all teams provided the same support.

Nor does the approval amount to immediate permanent resident status. According to the original version, follow-up still relates to immigration categories, priority dates and the availability of visa quotas; individual cases should be judged in consultation with licensed immigration lawyers.

How can Chinese students choose a job search area between California, Texas and New York?

The more practical order is:Targeted jobs are identified, employers are screened, and finally areas are compared.The industrial distribution referred to in the report could help establish a search scope, but could not be a substitute for specific job studies.

RegionIndustrial characteristics mentioned in the reportWhat do you need to check when looking for a job?
California.Science and technology and start-upsTechnical orientation, job requirements and firm-specific guarantee policies
TexasHas an important business and technology centreTeam location, job responsibilities and job authorization requirements
New YorkCentralization of finance, professional services, etc.Line matching, recruitment requirements and long-term guarantee arrangements

When applying for a SDE, DA or DS job, you can establish a list of employers around the technical and business teams; when applying for a financial job, you can focus on the New York business lines, but there is no need to limit searching to a single state.

It is proposed that the target positions be organized into a comparable list:

  • Job Match: Skills, project and experience match job requirements.
  • Identity support: Whether work authorizations, H1B and occupational migration policies are separately confirmed.
  • Actual cost: Are remuneration, housing, commuting and relocation arrangements acceptable?
  • Sources of evidence: Distinguishing between job advertisements, responses from recruiters and formal corporate policies.

If you need to check the statistics, you can USCIS official migration data pageThe search for the relevant report; it concerns the eligibility and processing path of the individual and should not be based solely on state news.

Common problems

Are California Green Cards 2026 claims the best in America?

The reports on which this paper is based are insufficient to confirm this ranking. The original text only specified the combined ratio of the three cantons and requested further reference to the cantonal tables to confirm the number of cantons.

Going to Texas to find a job. Would H1B have a higher signature rate?

This I-140 data does not support this conclusion. The choice of Texas should be based on job, employer policy and personal conditions, rather than speculating that it would be easier to draw lots locally.

Did I-140 get the green card?

Nope. Approval is a different step from the eventual acquisition of permanent resident status, and the categories, priority dates and visa quotas remain to be considered.

Should Chinese students vote only for California, Texas and New York?

It is not recommended that other states be excluded from this statistics alone. It would be more reasonable to prioritize the selection of matching employers who are willing to support work authorizations and subsequent guarantees for comparison.

---

Key points

  • Microsoft VEO covers approximately 60,000 employees in India, the United States, the United Kingdom and Canada with registration deadline 1 December 2026Separations are expected by the end of December.
  • The VEO was not a strong sanctioner this time, but the superseding Microsoft had reduced its staff by 4,800 in July this year, and the number of layoffs continued to grow throughout 2026.
  • United States Area Compensation Program: Level 64 and the following earns one week of basic salary every six months and Level 65-67 2 weeks every six months.Maximum compensation of 39 weeks。

  • Under the flag of Rexpand, AI Agent reaches 100+ company Hiring Team per week and continues to produce 5-15 introspective opportunities for participants in the workforce retrenchment.

---

perm-tcs-h1b-26xml.body:
In October 2026, the United States Department of Labor (DOL) formally suspended the processing of PERM labour certification for eight major technology companies, Microsoft, TCS, Infosys and others. PERM is the first necessary step for H1B holders to move towards a green card, and this suspension means that hundreds of thousands of foreign engineers from affected companies have been put on hold indefinitely - but the current H1B identity itselfNot affected, not canceled.。

---

Key points

  • The eight tech giants, Perm, were suspended.Including Microsoft, Adobe, TCS, Infosys, Wipro, HCL, Cognizant, Capgemini (source: Jagran Josh, 2026-10-12).
  • The current H1B visa status is not affected by this suspension.The process of renewal and change of identity continues as usual.
  • PERM Applicants granted earlier than this suspensionForm I-140 can still be submitted.
  • Both Microsoft and TCS have issued official statements emphasizing compliance records and committing to uninterrupted client service.
  • Immigration lawyers recommended that their own PERM progress and visa status be thoroughly verified before making any jump decision.

---

Which eight companies were affected by the PERM moratorium?

The U.S. Department of Labor is targeting H1B companies that use the largest amounts of technology and outsourced services. The companies affected were as follows:

In an official statement, Microsoft specifically states: "The vast majority of our H-1B applications are for renewal or change of status of existing employees, with new employees accounting for about 1 per cent of the total United States employees. TCS, for its part, states in the Exchange Bulletin: "Our human resource strategy in the United States, centred on recruiting local talent, has created a large local workforce in 31 offices in the United States."

---

Does H1B's current identity fail? What exactly does PerM pause affect?

This is one of the most focused questions for the student population at present, and the answer needs to be clear:

  • Current status of H1B visas, including in companies affected by the moratorium
  • H1B Extension and Change of Identity
  • Daily client project delivery and corporate operations

Part directly suspended:

  • PERM applications pending, pending completion of regulatory review

Exceptions not affected:

  • If your PerM applicationGranted prior to suspensionForm I-140 (immigration applications)

Immigration lawyers generally recommended that the decision not to change jobs be taken in haste and that the employer HR or immigration lawyer should first confirm their specific PERM progress points.

---

What are the current coping strategies of H1B holders?

For foreign technicians affected by the moratorium, the immigration legal profession is proposing the following possible paths:

1. Verification of your PERM time node

  • Confirms whether the application has been approved by DOL before the stay takes effect
  • If granted, confirm immediately with counsel the timing of I-140 submission

2. Assessment of H1B employer conversion possibilities

  • H1B Holders may change employers without losing eligibility to apply for a green card
  • If the new employer is not on the moratorium list, the new employer can restart the PERM process

3. Consider internal L-1A/L-1B redeployments

  • If the company has an overseas branch, it can assess lateral transfers to overseas offices through the L-1 category
  • Suitable for employees with transnational business needs who are willing to leave the United States temporarily.

4. Focus on the progress of regulatory reviews

  • Multiple immigration lawyers predict that the affected companies will complete their administrative review in the coming quarters, after which the PERM processing is expected to resume
  • Suggests the DOL Official Bulletin Reminder (dol.gov), first-time access policy update

Trainees at Rexpand MediumWe found that the easiest mistake for engineers with H1B was to wait for notice -- but the migration policy window was short, pre-regulating their PERM priority dates (Priority Date) and I-140 states, often leading to more initiative.

Common problems

Perm's pause will cause my H1B to be canceled? I won't. This time the Ministry of Labour suspended the processing of PERM labour certification applications from eight specific companies, the legal validity of the H1B work visa itself was not affected, and the renewal process followed as usual.

I work for Microsoft/TCS. Perm has been submitted but not approved. What now? Your application is probably on hold, suggesting that you immediately contact the company HR or immigration lawyer to confirm the situation. If the application has been granted before the stay takes effect, it may proceed with I-140; if it is still pending, it will be subject to regulatory review.

How long does Perm pause? When will it recover? A clear timetable for recovery has yet to be published. The immigration legal profession generally predicts that once the administrative compliance review of the affected companies with DOL is completed, the processing will resume over the next few quarters, but on the date specified in the official bulletin dol.gov.

If I switch to a company that's not on the moratorium, can I start Perm again? Yes. H1B The change of employer does not affect the eligibility for the green card and the new employer can restart the PERM process for you. It should be noted, however, that the Priority Date (priority date) is tied to the original employer ' s PERM, and that a new queue is usually required after the jump.

What concrete impact does this suspension have on finding jobs for Chinese students? There will be uncertainty as to the timing of the start of the green card process upon entry into office if the target company is just one of the eight affected enterprises. It is suggested that the company's PERM compliance be proactively questioned during the negotiation phase of the offer, or that preference be given to employers who are not on the suspension list.

h-1b-eeoc-0xg6t.dek: SibiTalent, a Texas IT recruitment firm, was sued by EEOC for an e-mail with the name "only H-1B", reflecting the true grey area of the student job market.
h-1b-eeoc-0xg6t.body:
In October 2026, the United States Equal Employment Opportunity Commission (EEOC) formally sued the Texas IT Recruitment Company, SibiTalent, for explicitly excluding United States citizens by naming “Only H-1B” in their recruitment mail with a large red high-profile font. This case shows that the use of visa status by an employer or intermediary as a condition for selection may constitute discrimination under United States federal law on the basis of nationality, and that it is necessary for a student to understand both sides of the legal red line in seeking employment.

---

Key points

  • EEOC filed a suit against SibiTalent in 2026Case No. 3:2026cv11106, Federal District Court for the Northern District of California.
  • Only H-1B is a clear illegal signal.The President of EEOC, Andrea Lucas, indicated that visa requirements as an alternative to nationality discrimination would be pursued.
  • Discrimination against American citizens.In this case, an American citizen seeking employment in Oakley, California, received the e-mail and filed a complaint.
  • IT Long-standing visa status bias in recruitment industry Okay.This case is a clear signal from the regulator.
  • For OPT/H-1B holdersTo know which "preferences" are legal and which cross borders have a direct impact on job safety and protection.

---

What happened to Only H-1B?

According to EEOC Memorial (Source:US Equal Employment Opportunity Commission v. SibiTalentOctober 2026, the timeline for the event is as follows:

  • July 2025SibiTalent recruiters sent e-mails to a worker in Oakley, California, for a business data analyst position in Mountain View, California.
  • Top of Mail byLarge black font, red highlight."Only H-1B."
  • The job-seeker asked whether the wording was legal and the recruiter responded only to “yeah” and not thereafter.
  • SibiTalent, both candidates who were finally recommended to the client.Indian and Nepalese nationality。
  • 5 October 2026: EEOC filed a formal complaint.
