ai-mbbib-ww303.body:
In 2026, AI was systematically reshaping the primary recruitment structure of the legal, investment and advisory professions. According to Revelio Labs, the number of intestary-level positions in the United States declined from January 2023 to mid-2025. 35%AI is the main driver. For Chinese students who are holding OPT/H1B status and are sprinting on finance and counselling, this is not a short swing, but a structural rewriting of bottom logic in the workplace.

---

Key points

  • Entry-level position dropsData from Revelio Labs show that between the beginning of 2023 and mid-2025, the United States experienced a reduction of about 35 per cent in primary jobs and that the legal, advisory and investment sectors were the worst hit areas.
  • McKinsey has tested AI operations at the endSince January 2026, candidates have been required to study the case of the McKinsey AI platform Lilli in interviews; similar BCG mechanisms expect Summer 2026 to go online.
  • The legal profession is structural reorganization, not net layoffs.Baker McKenzie reduced 600 to 1,000 operational support posts in February 2026, but new roles such as Legal Operations expanded rapidly.
  • "Seniorly biased technological change" has been confirmed by academics.: Harvard Economist ' s 2025 work paper noted that primary employment declined significantly for companies using the Generating AI, and higher-level employment continued to grow over the same period.
  • The student response window is still in place, but more demandingThe candidate who can "manage AI, question AI output, give independent judgment" is the very person for whom the major companies are willing to pay the premium.

---

AI What are the specific replacements for junior positions?

For a long time, the core work of the Bank ' s analysts, consultants, BA/RA, legal assistants has included:

  • Document Review / Contract Analysis
  • Preparation of the preliminary study synthesis and report
  • Financial Modeling
  • Data collation and PowerPoint Production

According to an in-depth analysis released by the Finnish Times on July 19, 2026,These assignments together account for approximately 60 per cent - 70 per cent of the working hours of a junior professional officerI don't know. Large language models and AI Agent can now do that in a few minutes.

Harvard economist Sayed Hosseini and Guy Lichtinger named this phenomenon in their work paper in 2025. "seniority-biased technical change"In the same company, there was a sharp decline in the number of primary and higher-level jobs.

IndustryAI Main primary functions affectedNew/expanded roles for the same period
Investment/ FinanceFinancial Modeling, data collation, first draft reportAI workflow management, advanced client policy
Management consultingResearch synthesis, PPT production, data analysisAI Tool Integration Consultant, Client Relations
Legal servicesDocument Review, contract analysis, legal researchLegal Operations, AI Output Audit Commissioner
Cross-practiceRepeated analysis and researchThe Senior post that commands AI.

---

McKinsey / BCG 2026, what's the new interview format?

This is the practical change that needs to be understood most in 2026 job applications.

Lilli test for McKinsey(as from January 2026):

  • Candidates must use the McKinsey Self-Research AI Platform at the end of the day Lilli Analysis of a case
  • The interviewer assessed three things:How to ask (prompt)、How to question AI output、Is it possible to draw independent, client-friendly conclusions?
  • It's not an AI test, it's a test.Judgment in the presence of AI

BCG & Bain Follow-up：

  • BCG is reportedly developing a similar AI interview module for Summer 2026
  • Bain's counterpart plan is also being developed according to the hiring experts.

McKinsey CEO Bob Sternfels disclosed on CES in January 2026: the company's current agreement 40,000 human employees and 25,000 AI Agents Parallel work - the latter saved the company all year in 2025. 1.5 million hours Search and synthesis of workload. He described it as "25-squared": client-oriented consulting positions increased by about 25 per cent and non-visiting positions decreased by about 25 per cent, but output did not increase.

What does it mean to stay in school: It's not enough to just do the case, and the interviewer will now see if you can give better answers with AI support, not be replaced by AI.

---

Is the legal profession "general layoffs" or "structural restructuring"?

This is the most easily misreadable part of the data itself:

  • U.S. legal employment reached approximately January 2026 12.4 millionYes. Ten years old.(Source: United States Bureau of Labor Statistics BLS)
  • In the same period, Baker McKenzie was downsized in February 2026. 600 per 1,000 operational support positionsIt's the biggest single AI reduction in the legal profession to date.
  • Clifford Chance reduced British operations support staff by 2025. About 10%
  • Irwin Mitchell was abolished during the same period. All legal assistant positions

The contradictory explanation is:AI eliminated elementary "doing things" while creating new jobs to manage how AI does things.

The Legal Operations Commissioner — a position that was virtually non-existent five years ago — is now one of the fastest growing positions in the legal profession. Its core functions are to manage the integration of AI tools with the workflow of lawyers, assess AI output quality, and maintain the audit trail of AI-assisted work results.

A student's opportunity to judgeThe legal profession has an identity threshold for international students, but the students of Legal Tech / Legal Operations in the direction of technical background (CS, data analysis) are new.

---

Common problems

How hard is the competition for student-student sprinting at the investment/consultation board in 2026? The total number of Entry-Leve posts fell by about 35 per cent, but the top companies did not stop recruiting, but substantially raised the standard -- from being able to do analysis to being able to direct AI to do analysis and independently judge. The competitive intensity of innovation is high, but the path of differentiation remains.

McKinsey, do you really want to take AI now? What do I need to learn in advance? Yes, McKinsey has been testing candidates' ability to use Lilli since January 2026. The core is not prompt english, but a critical judgement of AI output. It is suggested to practice "question AI's answer" and "fastly form an independent view" in daily case practice.

AI Under impact, which direction are the entry-level positions relatively safe? In the light of the current industry dynamics, client relations, posts requiring high-level interpersonal communication and on-site judgement (e.g., crient-facing consulting, IBD Corporation) and new technical positions (Legal Operations, AI Workflow Management, Quantitative Strategy) are at risk; purely repetitive research and paperwork are at the highest risk.

How much time do I have to get a job while OPT is out of work? STEM OPT Graduates with maximum cumulative unemployment 150 days(approximately 5 months) 90 daysI don't know. In the period of market contraction, it was suggested that the network and internal push channels should be maintained on a proactive basis, rather than waiting for unemployment to begin searching.

If my background is not top school/GPA, is there any chance in this market? Yes, but there is a need to proactively create differentiated signals - real project experience, industry push, and works that demonstrate the ability to apply the AI tool. Passive CVs had a very low success rate in the market in 2026, and introspection and mentor connectivity remained a breakthrough.

2026-pe-y7z4g.body:
In 2026, the pay gap between top and average positions was more than 10 times greater in the United States financial industry — Private Equity Partners could earn between $1 million and $10 million per year + and Investment Banking Managing Director would earn between $1 million and $3 million per year, while financial industry practitionersThe median annual salary is only about $80,920.(Source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Stateistics, 2024). If you are a student who is looking for a job, knowing the pay map is the first step in setting goals, anchoring the track, negotiating offer.

---

Key points

  • PE Partner It was the financial sector pay ceiling in 2026, with a total income of $1M–$10M+, with the core driving force being capital allocation and carry split.
  • IB Managing Director An annual salary of $1M per $3M, the value of which is converted from a customer relationship to a transaction cost, not simply a technical capability.
  • Quant Researcher / Analyst It is one of the most accessible high-paying paths for students, with high technical barriers and stable demand.
  • In the financial sector, "the upwards and the non-linear" - the median salary for ordinary workers is $80,920, and the top position is 10 to 100 times higher.
  • The key to keeping students on the high-paying track is locking them in vertical (QI / IB / PE)+ introspection + real project endorsement.

---

The following data is compiled from the Business Model Analyst Top 10 Best Paying Jobs in Finance for 2026 and the Extern industry payroll guide, which combines U.S. Bureau of Labor Stateistics.

---

What makes every high-paid job? A student needs to understand the bottom logic.

Behind the paycheck is...Methods of value creationThe difference is not a simple accumulation of seniority. The report made it clear that the financial companies paid the most, those who could.Originate transactions, pricing risks, fund-raising, capital allocationPeople -- not just people who do spreadsheet.

Investment Banking Managing Director The core value is the transformation of the customer relationship into a Fee Pool. One of the top MD controls is customer trust and transaction flow, not technical detail. High-paying MDs are usually deep-drop in a vertical area (e.g., healthcare, tech, energy transformation) and can be contacted by the board of directors on its own initiative before the process starts. Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley, JP Morgan, Lazard and Centerview Partners all highly endorse the model.

Hedge Fund Manager Some 80 per cent of hedge funds have been lost and eventually closed, but a few head funds account for the bulk of industry profits and talent. "2% overhead plus 20% excess gain" 2&20 The structure means that the larger the AUM, the more stable the alpha, the closer the administrator ' s income to no ceiling.

Quant Researcher / Analyst For a student, this is...Technical barriers are highest and at the same time most accessibleHigh-paying path. The mathematical/statistical/CS background is needed to build quantitative models, price derivatives and optimize the portfolio. The salary range is $200,000 – $500,000 + and top-level quantitative funds (e.g. Two Sigma, Citadel) can exceed $500,000 full-time packages.

CFO The CFO of elite enterprises is not just the "financial director", but rather the capital structure policymakers and board strategic staff. The report stressed that top companies were willing to pay a heavy price for the seat because of the direct impact of the CFO on financing costs, capital efficiency and investor confidence.

---

The dilemma of many students is not ability, but...Lack of access: No interior push, no project background, no idea how to reach Hiring Manager. Based on our 300+ participant experience, the following are proven paths:

  • Quantified investments (QI): suitable for mathematical/statistical/CS background, with Quant Researcher/Trader orientation
  • Modelling of the Institute (FM/IB): Fit to financial/accounting/economic context, target IB Analyst →Associate →MD channel
  • Data Science (DS/DA): For participants who want to join Fintech or the management team

Don't go in three directions at the same time, lock in early, build up vertical experience.

Step two: endorsement with real project outputs

Our AI Agent reaches 100+ Hiring Team per week with 5-15 effective introspections; the Email Library covers 1 million+, with a response rate of about 20%. It's not a seaway resume, it's a direct match. The participants in our tutorship have obtained offers from Goldman Sachs, J. P. Morgan, Morgan Stanley, Citi, UBS, Deutsche Bank, Meta, Google, Amazon, TikTok, Stripe, BCG, Deloitte, etc., all of which are certified.

What was the average pay in the financial sector in 2026? According to U.S. Bureau of Labor Stateistics, the median annual salary for the financial and business professions as a whole is approximately $80,920 (2024 data). However, there is a wide gap between the annual income of US$ 1 million and US$ 10 million plus for head positions (PE Partners, IB MD).

What is the first year's salary? IB Analyst (1st grade) base salary at top investment lines (e.g. Goldman Sachs, JP Morgan) usually amounts to $110,000-$125,000, plus a gross salary of $150,000-$200,000+ after year-end bonus, due to firm and market cycle fluctuations.

Which one of Quant and IB are better suited to stay? Both paths are feasible, with a critical background: the mathematics/statistics/CS profession is better suited to the Quant route, the pay ceiling is high and language requirements are relatively low; the finance/accounting profession is better suited to the IB route, but requires strong networking and internal support.

Can you get into a high-paying financial position without a college background? Yes, but it needs to be used.Project Background + Inner Push + Interview PreparationTo compensate for the lack of educational labels. Among the trainees we mentored were non-predominant 50 school backgrounds that were systematically prepared for the real cases of Goldman Sachs, Capital One and others.

h-1b-offer-pyzek.title: The H-1B system is exposed to a "recurring offender employer".
h-1b-offer-pyzek.dek: The United States Department of Labor has officially opened an investigation into H-1B, and leading outsourcing giants such as Cognizant have been subpoenaed and repeated violations have allowed them to continue applying for quotas, and it is important that the choice of employer by the student remains open.
h-1b-offer-pyzek.body:
In 2026, the U.S. Department of Labor officially launched a large-scale fraud investigation into H-1B and PERM systems, and Cognizant and other "repeated violations" employers were listed on the summons list, but still hold thousands of H-1B quotas - This is a key signal for the students studying for OPT to H1B:Your employer's qualifications determine your identity directly.I don't know. Prior to the delivery of the curriculum vitae, the H-1B compliance record of the employer was not "plus" but a hard threshold.

---

Key points

  • In July 2026, the United States Department of Labor announced an investigation into H-1B and PERM systemsA summons was sent to dozens of companies, including Cognizant.
  • The Layoffhedge database showsThe cumulative H-1B labour status application (LCA) in 2015-2026 was as high as6,835,000 copiesThe scale of systemic abuse is large.
  • The "Body shop" outsourcing model is a high-risk area.Cognizant cumulative applications since 2009 Super52,000 copiesH-1B, 2024, jury ruling on excess2,000.There is deliberate discrimination against non-Indian employees.
  • Repeaters don't automatically lose their quota eligibility.There are clear gaps in the legislation in force, and students are required to check their employer ' s history on their own initiative.
  • OPT stage jumps or accepts offerCompliance employer > High payoffer, whose identity is directly impaired if H-1B is rejected or revoked.

---

What exactly was the H-1B Employers ' Infraction Survey 2026?

In July 2026, Anthony D'Esposito, Inspector General of the United States Department of Labor, officially announced that an investigation would be conducted into the H-1B visa system and the PerM (Program Electronic Review Management) permanent labour certification system to combat systemic fraud. Cognizant is one of dozens of companies named.

The investigation focused on three categories of violations:

  • "Benching."After the employer applied for H-1B, the holder waited for the undistributed job without paying the salary. According to Cognizant's court documents,40% of the company ' s H-1B holders remained in India for six months after approval.It's illegal.
  • Fake jobs.The H-1B application is subject to a specific post and may not be "stocked". However, the evidence shows that Cognizant applied for a large number of H-1B places without actual posts.
  • Replacement of American workers(b) Enterprises using H-1B foreign workers to replace (rather than supplement) local United States employees are suspected of violating "non-alternative" provisions of labour law.

---

What does the Cognizant judgement data say?

Cognizant is currently the most representative case of a violation in the H-1B system, the data of which are specific and verified by the court and deserve careful attention by the students.

IndicatorsData
Total global staffAbout 340,000.
Percentage of Indian employeesAbout 70%
Number of H-1B applications from 2009 to dateOver 52,000 (the highest in the United States)
Number of H-1Bs, 2020-20246,400 copies, of which 80% + only in scientific level
The number of employees involved in discriminatory decisions in 2024Over 2,000 non-Indian employees
Amount of compensation in the case of Professor NYU, 2026$8.4 million
Dismissal/separation ratio of United States staffHolders of H-1B visasTwo times.
Dismissal rate of black employeesAsian employees.23 times.

Source: Bloomberg Investigation Report 2024, Court Documents.

More alarmingly:Cognizant was still allowed to continue applying for H-1B quotas after the above violations became knownI don't know. Bloomberg's report for the same period states that "each of the five major outsourcing companies has had a discriminatory suit in the last four years - a lost, settled or still in litigation, but all can still apply for H-1B".

---

OPT to H1B: How to identify "high-risk employers"?

For students who are seeking employment at the OPT stage and are waiting for a drawing of lots from H-1B, employer screening is the first step in identity management. The following is an operational verification path:

Step 1: Check employer H-1B application records

  • Visits USCIS official H-1B data(free public)
  • Check the number of H-1B applications per year, approval rate, rejection rate of targeted companies
  • Vigilance: companies with a very large number of applications but an exceptionally low approval rate

Step 2: Identify "Body Shot" feature

The following signals suggest that the employer may be a high-risk outsourcing model:

  • The company's main business is IT Stuffing / Consulting.
  • Offer says you'll be posted to a third-party client site.
  • Wages below median in the same job market (available) DOL LCA database）
  • List of companies in H-1B Let's go.

Step 3: Verification of the history of labour violations

  • The U.S. Department of Labor official network Wage and Hour Divingdol.gov/agencies/whd
  • Google Search "The name of the company + H-1B lawsuit / disclosure"

Step 4: Comparative academic structure

Bloomberg data show that outsourced company H-1B holders, such as CognizantOver 80% of all science history.And Amazon, Apple, Meta. MediumAbout 60% are masters and aboveI don't know. The academic structure indirectly reflects the size and stability of the position.

---

What kind of employer H-1B is safe?

Not all H-1B employers are at high risk. The following comparisons help to make judgements:

Type of employerFeaturesIdentity risk level
Direct employer (Big Tech)Self-employed engineers, transparent pay, good compliance record.Low
Financial institutions (IB/Asset Mgmt)Pay is regulated and internal compliance is improvedLow
Consulting firm (MBB/Big4)Client presence but pay compliance, legal team integrityMedium
Small and medium-sized IT consultancy/outsourcingPay pressure is low, Benching is more risky.High
Body Shop.No substantive employment relationship, LCA compliance questionedIt's very high.

Among the trainees we mentored, after receiving the "high-pay" outsourcing offer, a cross-check of payroll data found that the LCA had claimed less than the prevailing wage... Once such cases are investigated by DOL, H-1B may be directly revoked and its identity immediately enters a dangerous period.The choice of an offer cannot be based solely on numbers, but depends more on whether the employer can afford verification.

---

Common problems

Can I get an offer from the H-1B "Body Shot" employer? Recommendation not to be taken lightly. Under the Body shop model, there is greater uncertainty about your actual place of work, salary stability and H-1B compliance. It is recommended that a decision be taken first through the DOL LCA database to verify whether the declared wages have reached the prevailing age.

The employer was investigated by DOL and would H-1B have lapsed? The investigation itself did not automatically invalidate the existing H-1B, but if the authorization was withdrawn after the investigation, the signatory would have to leave within a reasonable time and find a new employer to complete the H-1B transfer, otherwise the identity would have appeared. Early preparation of alternative employers is the most important risk hedge.

How do we find out if a company is a "H-1B firm"? It can be accessed through the USCIS H-1B Employer Data Hub or DOL OFLC database. If the company is labelled H-1B dependent, it is legally required to prove that it is not a substitute for United States workers, but there are loopholes in the current enforcement, which still require self-verification.

How do you calculate the period of unemployment while OPT was fired by "Body Shot"? STEM OPT holder ' s cumulative period of unemployment cannot exceed150 days(non-STEM OPT as90 daysI'm not sure. In the event of dismissal, a job search procedure or a report to the DSO must be initiated immediately in order to avoid delays that would render the status invalid.

Did the 2026 H-1B drawing of lots affect the employment of the remaining students? The H-1B drawing of lots for the 2026 fiscal year (FY2027) was completed in early 2026, and the median signature rate was bound by the quota ceiling (conventional quota of 65,000 plus the master ' s exemption of 20,000), with the overall median signature rate in recent years being approximately 20-30 per cent. The employer's compliance does not affect the probability of drawing lots, but the H-1B application, which affects the rate of approval - a high irregular employer, may be subject to stricter scrutiny at the stage of adjudication.

2026-53-fokbp.body:
According to the latest June 2026 data from WSJ, United States enterprise size reductions decreased by 53 per cent, the most visible sign of market stability since 2026. For North American Chinese students who are looking for jobs or are about to enter the market, this means that the delivery window is opening — but the differences between industries are still significant, and selection is more important for companies and sectors than for “wide distribution”.

---

Key points

  • Retrenchment rate down 53%: WSJ data show that the size of the June 2026 lay-offs was significantly lower than the previous month, marking the strongest recovery this year.

  • The job search window has been opened: Market harvests are shrinking and the pace of release of HC (head count) is accelerating, and now is a good time to take the initiative.
  • Corporate health is more important than industry labels.: Within the same industry, companies with stable profits are in a very different position from companies with expanding losses.
  • Students need to pay special attention to sector stability.H1B / OPT identity is more sensitive to the post-defunct buffer period and more careful selection.

---

What does a 53 per cent reduction in staff in 2026 mean?

Retrenchment data tracked by WSJ show that in June 2026 the size of the enterprise was about 53 per cent lower than the previous peak ring ratio. This figure represents a significant decline in the number of staff reductions that have continued for more than a year.

What do you mean, "stable"? What do you mean, "full warmth"?

  • Steady.There has been a reduction in the number of new staff reductions, but stock positions have not been filled on a large scale.
  • Warming.: HC re-release, upper-rate and salary levels.
  • Current stageCloser to "stable," some of the front companies have started to make up small amounts, but far from the crazy 2021 expansion.

For students to stay, the signals at this stage are:Active delivery is initiated with precision screening and not without distinction.

---

Which industries still have structural risks? What's warming up?

Not all industries recovered simultaneously. WSJ reports that large enterprises in the fields of science, technology and finance are still undergoing structural adjustments — which means that even if the overall number of layoffs drops, there is still a downsizing within the two industries.

Retrenchment is a sign of the market, but the pace of seeking employment for students is earlier and more accurate than for local students - because OPT has a hard limit on the number of days of unemployment (the cumulative period of unemployment during STEM OPT is not more than 150 days) and the H1B drawing window has a fixed rhythm.

h1b-microsoft-5bqoc.title: The big H1B is being targeted!
h1b-microsoft-5bqoc.dek: Microsoft was caught on H1B compliance charges, STEM OPT was targeted, visa clearance for major plants was upgraded, and the uncertainty of transferring students to H1B surged.
h1b-microsoft-5bqoc.body:
In 2026, Microsoft was subjected to large-scale allegations by social media about its H1B employment policy, and the risk of visa compliance for major plants officially surfaced. For Chinese students with F-1 or OPT status, this means that the uncertainty of the H1B conversion route is further increased — advance visa planning and selection of employers is more critical than ever.

---

Key points

  • Microsoft faces H1B compliance chargesThe social media are passionate about the links between their historical lobbying and STEM OPT policies, and the pressure for visa review in large factories is rising.
  • STEM OPT is at risk of being called off at any time: The Trump government has the executive power to terminate STEM OPT directly without parliamentary authorization, but the policy window is likely to close at any time.
  • The focus of enforcement at this stage is still on IT outsourcing in IndiaLarge technology companies have not been the main targets for the time being, but public opinion pressure is changing this pattern.
  • The National Assembly's continuing deadlock over immigration legislationThe current H1B system will not be completely re-engineered in the short term, but the annual drawing of lots remains intense.
  • Policy on student retentionEarly accumulation of background, access to large-scale in-house push and reduction of the OPT unemployment window are the most effective means of reducing risk at this time.

---

What about Microsoft's H1B charge?

In recent days, a widely disseminated social media report has noted that Microsoft has long been a strong lobby for the expansion of STEM OPT policy. In 2016, following Congress ' s rejection of legislative action, the Obama Government extended administratively the mandate of STEM OPT for international students to 36 months, essentially providing an alternative route for a large number of students to bypass the H-1B annual ceiling (65,000 places). Critics argue that this mechanism allows large technology companies, such as Microsoft, to employ international talent on a continuous basis, without being constrained by the volume of H1B, thus reducing employment opportunities for indigenous workers.

Key notesThe report originated from the reproduction and interpretation of earlier statements by a politician in social media, not from official USCIS or official government investigative documents. Microsoft ' s position is that the law in force does not prohibit companies from continuing to apply for H1B visas and that they will continue to provide visa guarantees to employees in accordance with the law.

---

Does STEM OPT get canceled? Updated Risk Assessment 2026

Does Trump government have the power to cancel STEM OPT?

Yes. STEM OPT is not a piece of Congress legislation, but is established by executive rules (DHS regulation), and the current Government can be amended or repealed without parliamentary approval. This was the biggest policy overhang for students in 2026.

What is the current direction of law enforcement?

According to available public information, the focus of law enforcement in 2026 was still concentrated on the Indian IT outsourcing company (staffing/consulting firm), with large technology companies (MSC, Google, Meta, etc.) not yet the main target. According to some analysts, the close relationship between the big technology company CEO and the White House provides some covert protection for these companies.

Policy variablesCurrent status (2026-07)Potential risk level
STEM OPT (36-month authorization)Still valid, not abolished• High (administrative rectification at any time)
H1B annual ceiling (65,000 + 20,000 graduate students)Maintenance(Congress deadlock)
H1B drawing of lotsCurrent random drawing of lotsMedium (under discussion on reform)
Large H1B Employer GuaranteeKeep it working.• Low (no restrictions on existing laws)
Visa review for IT outsourcing companiesIt's very tight.It's very high.

---

OPT to H1B: What are the processes and time lines of greatest concern to students?

For students with F-1 status, the standard routes for entering the workplace after graduation are:

F-1 graduation OPT (12 months) STEM OPT extension (+ 24 months) H1B drawing of lots and entry into force of H1B

Critical time nodes and figures (based on existing USCIS regulations):

  • OPT Application WindowSubmitted 90 days before graduation and 60 days after graduation
  • STEM OPT Extension: 90 days before the expiry of OPT, employer must register E-Verify
  • H1B lot registration window: March of each year (FY2027 drawing of lots expected March 2027)
  • H1B effective date: 1 October each year (FY starts)
  • Unemployment tolerance days during OPT: Accumulated for up to 90 days (same 90 days for STEM OPT phase), exceeding or not in compliance

How intense was the 2026 H1B drawing of lots?

The number of H1B applicants has continued to exceed the ceiling several times in recent years. USCIS has implemented severe measures for duplicate registration (which can only be registered once a year per person), but competitive pressures remain high. Large factory offer + strong background = increased probability of employers being willing to support visas on a continuous basis, which is the most important variable for students to control.

---

How should a student be prepared for an upgrade of the visa review for a major factory?

In the current environment, we have observed several clear trends in mentoring:

1. Selection of employers is more important than ever Large plants (Goldman Sachs, Google, Amazon, Meta, Apple, Stripe, etc.) that have long-term guarantees of H1B and have their own record of compliance should have higher priority than small outsourcing companies or startup.

2. The stronger the background, the smaller the visa risk The employer's willingness to adhere to the core logic of the guarantee during the uncertain period of the visa is that the employee is "worthy". Solid project experience, large plant internships, quantifiable results are bargaining chips.

3. Pre-locking internal thrusts and shortening delivery cycles OPT has a maximum number of days of unemployment (90 days) and is more passive in seeking employment. Screening of black holes through internal pushes directly bypasses the curriculum vitae is the most direct means of speeding.

4. Do not use STEM OPT as an infinite buffer. The policy is likely to tighten at any time, ideally in the first year of OPT, when H1B lot registration is completed, rather than relying on 36 months of extension "to find work slowly".

---

Common problems

Will Microsoft continue to apply for H1B for employees? Yes. Microsoft ' s official position is clear: the law in force does not prohibit companies from applying for H1B and companies will continue to provide visa guarantees to eligible employees. Allegations are based on social media and public opinion, and are officially investigated by non-governmental organizations.

What if STEM OPT is cancelled and a student is already in STEM OPT? If the Government abolishes STEM OPT, the follow-up impact of approved personnel depends on specific policy transition arrangements, and historical precedents show that there is usually a grace period. The policy is still in force and it is recommended that sustained attention be paid to the USCIS Network of Officials (uscis.gov) and the DHS Bulletin.

Will HR refuse me for visa issues? Legal employers may not discriminate against candidates on the grounds of "needing a visa" (protected by INA § 274B), but some small companies in the field may decline on the grounds of "non-sponsorship". Large factories generally have a complete visa support system, with priority given to targeted delivery when seeking employment.

After the H1B drawing of lots, will the company cancel offer due to censorship pressure? Theoretically possible, but rarely in the history of large plants. More commonly, the risk is USCIS issuing RFE (additional evidence notice) to the claim. The selection of employers with professional teams of immigration lawyers can significantly reduce this risk.

I haven't found a job yet. What should I do first? Start immediately: 1 combo and strengthen the project context; 2 activate alumni and industry push networks; 3 develop a clear OPT day management plan. Three in parallel. Don't wait until the policy is clear.

---

perm-1-v2l6a.title: Green card PerM is scheduled for over a year.
perm-1-v2l6a.dek: Recent data from the United States Department of Labor: The PERM labour certification backlog of about a year, with longer audit cases and severe tests on the employer-sponsored green card route.
perm-1-v2l6a.body:
As of June 30, 2026, the United States Department of Labor (DOL) PERM labour certification backlog was over a year old. June or earlier, 2025The deadline for the submission of applications for audit cases was only December 2025. For Chinese students who rely on employers to sponsor the route of employment-based green card, this means that the entire Green Card time line has to be moved back together and that advance planning is now an urgent matter.

---

Key points

  • PERM Normal Application: DOL as of 2026-06-30 processed cases filed in June 2025, scheduled More than 12 months。
  • Audit (Audit) cases are slower: Applications selected for audit, currently closed in December 2025, with a longer timeline.
  • Prevailing Wage: OEWS salary recognition processed to April 2026, non-OEWS processed to March 2026.
  • Perm, green card first.PerM is authorized to submit I-140 applications for immigration, and PERM delays the entire green card path.
  • Unstable policy environment: Trump government is discussing simultaneous changes to the PERM recruitment requirements and prevailing wage, which may further affect the employer sponsorship process.

---

In 2026, how long was Perm scheduled?

According to the latest processing progress report published by DOL on 30 June 2026 (source: DOL Foreign Labor Application Gateway/ FLAG portal), the current processing windows for various types of PERM applications are as follows:

Type of applicationCurrent processing deadline (DOL being processed)
PERM Labour Certification (General)2025 June or earlier Hand it over.
PERM Labour Certification (Audit Audit)Submitted in December or earlier
Reconsideration2026 February or earlier Hand it over.
Prevailing Wage（OEWS）2026 April or earlier Hand it over.
Prevailing Wage（non-OEWS）2026 March or earlier Hand it over.
Prevailing Wage2026 April or earlier Hand it over.
PERM Center Director Review2026 May or earlier Hand it over.

Core findings: The actual waiting time for regular PERM applications is approximately More than 12 months; cases selected for audit are awaiting longer periods of time and employers are required to provide complete recruitment records and supporting documentation to further lengthen the cycle.

---

Perm, what is it? Why is it stuck in the entire green card path?

PERM（Program Electronic Review Management） It is the most critical first step in the green card process for employers to sponsor.

The core logic is that an employer must certify to DOL that "the position cannot be located with a qualified American worker" before submitting an I-140 immigration application to the USCIS, and then initiate a process of queuing the priority date for follow-up with a review of status of status or consular clearance.

Why does Perm's backlog affect students?

  • Most of the Chinese students with OPT / H-1B are on the EB-2 or EB-3 employment-based green card route, and PERM approval must be pre-completed.
  • Once the PERM schedule has exceeded 12 months, the I-140 submission time has been delayed and the accumulation of priority dates has been delayed.
  • For applicants from mainland China, the priority date of EB-2/EB-3 has itself been severely reversed over a long period of time, with a backlog of PERM, and the overall green card waiting period may be ten years.

---

Green card application for student employer: which node should move?

For Chinese students studying at OPT or H-1B, the following time frame of reference is of concern:

The sooner we start, the smaller the risk of a backlog.

  • The PERM application could theoretically be started in the first year of H-1B, without having to wait until three years.
  • The employer is required to complete the process of advertising (usually 30-60 days) and internal review before formally submitting PERM, and to communicate more proactively than wait for notice.
  • If the employer has not started PERM and your OPT / H-1B has limited remaining time, the priority should beImmediate confirmation of green card sponsorship schedule with HR or immigration lawyer。

Audit risks require early containment

  • The percentage of DOL-selected audits is not regular and once triggered, the waiting period is extended for several months from the current benchmark.
  • Employers should prepare all recruitment records (advertisement screens, job-seeker screening records, interview records) in advance to reduce the cyclical risk of post-audit supplements.

Prevailing Wage.

  • The processing of prevaricating wage development (PWD) is significantly faster than that of the PERM body (currently processing applications in March-April 2026).
  • Employers can submit PWDs first, and then formally, after PWDs have been approved, to PERM, helping to benchmark wages and reduce the uncertainty of subsequent processing.

---

Policy context: Will potential reforms of the Trump government affect PERM?

The Trump Government is currently discussing a number of reforms for immigrants, including:

  • Modify PERM Recruitment Requirements• Possible increase in the threshold of proof for employers to prove "unqualified American workers".
  • Adjusting prevailing wage calculationAn increase in the wage base would directly affect the willingness and cost of the employer to sponsor.
  • H-1B Legislative amendmentsLinked to the PERM / Green Card process, the overall employer sponsored ecology or changes.

These policy discussions have not yet materialized into final rules, but have created additional uncertainty. In the case of students,Promote the start-up of PERM by employers as early as possible before the policy window tightens It is central to reducing long-term risks.

---

Common problems

How long does it take for the PERM to approve (update 2026)? According to the latest report issued by DOL on 30 June 2026, regular PERM applications are scheduled for more than 12 months (currently closed in June 2025); audit cases are longer and applications submitted in December 2025 are currently pending.

What does it mean to be audited? Following the selection of the PERM audit, DOL will require the employer to submit a full set of recruitment records and supporting documentation within a specified time frame, with a longer lead time than usual cases. The audit case intake window is currently only in December 2025, with actual queues exceeding even regular applications.

Could PERM start during OPT? Yes. The PERM application itself does not impose a requirement on the applicant ' s current status and the employer ' s will is crucial. The sooner the PERM is launched, the sooner the priority date (Priority Date) is set, especially important for applicants from mainland China who face a long schedule.

Prevailing Wage and PERM are the same process? Nope. Prevailing Wage Determination (PWD) is a pre-emptive step for PERM and is considered separately by DOL. Currently PWD processes faster than PerM (currently processed to March-April 2026) and suggests that employers submit PWDs first to save the whole time.

How long is the Green Card schedule for applicants born in mainland China? EB-2/EB-3 The priority dates for the birth category in mainland China have been severely reversed for a long time, adding to the current backlog of PERM for more than 12 months, and the overall path is usually calculated for several years or more. Depending on the type of employer, the type of position and the situation, it is recommended that professional immigration lawyers be consulted to assess the personal situation.

uber-h1b-27-410k-04yc7.body:
Uber submitted 364 H-1B applications in the first half of FY2026 (as at 31 March 2026), a decrease of 27 per cent compared to 497 in the same period last year, while increasing the annual salary of top software engineers to $410,000. The trend of low recruitment and high pay for elites is reshaping the demand structure of the technology industry for OPT holders. Understanding this change is more critical than ever for Chinese students who are sprinting on H1B transfers.

---

Key points

  • Uber H1B application dropped by 27%: 364 vss for the first half of FY2026, 497 for the same period last year, official data as of March 31, 2026.
  • Top engineers get $410,000 a year.The salary corresponds to the level of the Software Engineering Manager (Software Engineering Manager), which is also shown in the table below.
  • Two main driversThe Trump government raised the H1B application fee + Uber shifted the budget towards AI, and recruitment for traditional positions continued to slow.
  • Elite strategy: Total quota shrinks, but is willing to pay a premium for AI and core engineering positions - which means that competition is concentrated at a high level.
  • OPT Holder ImpactThe reduction in the number of H1B sponsor places means that the window reserved for the OPT forwarding candidate is narrower and that context-specific competition is more important.

---

Uber H1B application down 27%. What's the signal behind the number?

According to publicly declared data (source: Briefs Finance, citing Uber Official Fling), Uber submitted 364 H-1B submissions six months before FY2026, compared with 497 during the same period of FY2025, a 27 per cent decrease.

This is the result of a combination of two forces:

  • Increase in visa costsThe former government raised the H1B application fee last year, and the cost of each post increased significantly, making it more prudent for companies to judge whether or not to apply for the post.
  • AI investment priorities: Uber documents show that the company is requiring its employees to increase their personal productivity and channel more funds towards artificial intelligence, and that recruitment for traditional scale has been put on hold.

It is worth noting that the reduction in the number of applications was completely discontinued. Uber is still paying high salaries for the most critical AI and engineering leadership positions, a strategic shift of "total contraction and precision".

---

What is the salary range for Uber at H1B in 2026?

The payroll data are derived from the public files submitted by Uber to the USCIS on Labor Regulation Application (LCA), covering multiple functions such as engineering, products, data, operations, finance, etc.

But even Senior Data Scientist’s lower salary limit ($175,600) is well above the industry average, indicating that Uber remains willing to invest heavily in the remaining H1B holders.

For OPT candidates preparing for DS / DA / SE posts: high pay means high competition, and Uber ' s threshold for skill requirements is synchronized.

---

What practical impact does the reduction in H1B applications have on the transfer of OPT from Chinese students?

This is the central concern of many readers, and we have broken it down:

Impact dimension I: Less position of Sponsor

The reduction in the number of H1B places in a large plant such as Uber means that the total number of OPT candidates who are able to enter the H1B drawing pool through Uber each year has decreased. Science and technology industries are generally biased towards AI and automation, and the traditional SWE / PM / Ops posts are showing a decline in the willingness of sponsor.

Impact dimension two: competition in high-value jobs

Despite the decrease in the number of applications, the $410K level position is still in sponsor. This suggests that Uber (and similar large plants) is concentrating H1B resources on the most difficult replacements — AI research, ML engineering, key product decision-making.

Impact dimension three: Increase in value of non-large plant paths

When the top technology companies contracted the H1B quota, medium technology companies, financial science and technology, consultancy, banks, etc. were still stabilizing the value of their employers. Goldman Sachs, J.P. Morgan, Deloitte and others rely on H1B in a different structure than Uber, and the window remains.

Of our tutors.A number of people have secured stable H1B sponsor offer - including recruitment from Capital One, KPMG, Moody's, etc. - through financial, consulting tracks, after the main factory was closed. There is more than one road. The key is to set it up ahead.

---

H1B drawing of lots in 2026: Is the overall trend difficult or easy?

Uber is just a microcosm of industry. The overall context of the current H1B market is as follows:

OPT unemployment toleranceEmployers are more sensitive to the time window for OPT candidates and have a more visible advantage in early start-up

ConclusionsThe overall quota ceiling for H1B (65,000 + 20,000 undergraduates) remains unchanged, but the willingness to nominate major science and technology plants has declined, and competition has concentrated on subdivided high-level posts. For candidates with common backgrounds, the risk of relying on a single large plant path is higher than ever.

---

Common problems

Uber H1B's application dropped by 27%. Is my H1B chance less? The decline in the number of Uber individual applications did indeed reduce the number of places entering the drawing pool through the company, but the total volume of H1B cap remained the same for the entire industry. The key is to find the employer who is still active and to get offer and start the application process as early as possible during OPT.

Uber top engineer's salary is $410K. Is it all available? Nope. In addition, Cap-exempt employers (high schools, non-profit research institutions) are not subject to drawing of lots and are a viable path.

What does Uber cut H1B and AI invest in? The Uber document clearly indicates that the company is shifting its budget from traditional job recruitment to AI investment and is requiring existing staff to increase productivity. This means "do more with fewer people," which naturally reduces the demand for external H1B talent. This trend is also evident in large plants such as Meta and Google.

When did the 2026 H1B draw of lots begin? In accordance with USCIS practice, the registration window for the drawing of lots by FY2027 H1B (i.e., application submitted in 2026, effective 1 October 2026) is usually open at the beginning of March of each year for approximately two weeks. The exact date should be based on the USCIS official network (uscis.gov) announcement, recommending confirmation of the time line with the employer as soon as OPT becomes effective.

Under the current rules, the end date of the I-20 project is the actual stay period for F-1 visa students as long as they remain in full-time studies and meet the visa requirements, and the school DSO has the flexibility to extend the I-20 without having to apply for a separate extension of its identity from the USCIS.

Why did Big H1B declare a fall in 2026?

According to USCIS publicly declared data, the four former technology giants, Google, Meta, Microsoft and Amazon, who had long occupied the top of the H1B declaration list, registered a marked contraction in the number of new employees in 2026.

The main reasons include:

  • Reduction in overall recruitment: The new HC (headcount) in the head office of a large plant is strictly regulated by the continuing effects of the 2024-2025 surge.
  • Local talent priority strategy• Some companies have increased recruitment rates for indigenous graduates and green card holders under policy pressure.
  • AI replacement effectThe widespread availability of generating AI tools has reduced the demand for some primary jobs, particularly SDE New Grad, which are the main sources of notification for students.
  • Uncertainty in immigration policyWork visa scrutiny at the federal level increased in 2025-2026, increasing employers ' compliance costs and willingness to declare.

  • Robinwood, 10% reduction.The official qualification is a proactive strategic adjustment, a non-financial crisis, backed by AI and automated replacement posts.
  • Strong layoffs are the new normal for the Finnish industry.: High-growth companies no longer rely on head-to-head expansion, but instead streamline human costs with AI.
  • The search window for students still exists: Increased positions (data analysis, quantification, financial engineering) rather than replacements by AI tend to be more focused on highly skilled candidates.
  • The recruitment tempo will slow down in the short term.However, this does not amount to a complete closure; the priority of the internal push channels is much higher at this point than the Internet delivery.
  • Now is the best time to prepare for the next round of fintech recruitment.The improvement of project experience and introspective networks when competitors look at them can create clear advantages.

---

Robinhod, why lay off? What do you mean, "good business"?

The official statement of Robinhood is rather rare: This reduction was not due to losses or a shrinking market, but rather to management ' s proactive judgement that current operations are strong and that more can be done by a more streamlined team.

Behind this logic is a structural shift that is taking place throughout the science and finance industry:

  • AI tools take on a large number of repetitive tasks that would have required manual work.Including functions such as customer service, compliance review, data reporting, etc.
  • Automation increased single-person output ratio, the company can maintain or raise the revenue without expansion.
  • "Simplified is efficiency" becomes the new narrative.Retrenchment is packaged as strategic self-confidence rather than survival.

For job-seekers, it is essential to identify the difference in nature between these two types of layoffs:

Type of staff reductionTrigger causeImpact on recruitmentTypical signal.
Financial crisis typeLoss of revenue, breakdown of financingLong-term freeze on recruitment for the next 6-12 monthsManagement turnover, debt restructuring
Strategic optimization（Robinhood）AI/automated efficiency, active thinnessShort-term slowdown and recruitment of selected highly skilled staffOperational indicator health. Official emphasis on power.
Industry cycleMacro interest rates, regulatory pressuresResonance with industry as a whole, waiting for cycle reversalCommon synchronized staff reductions

Robinwood is in category II this time. This means that "AI collaboration" jobs such as data science, quantification, financial engineering and so on are likely to resume recruitment after a brief stagnation, but that purely manual, process-oriented jobs will not return.

---

AI Reorganization, which positions are worth fighting for?

The wave of "AI replacement" does not evenly cover all posts. According to industry trends and the observation of 300+ trainees, the following positions continue to be of high value to candidates for studies:

Positions worth highlighting:

  • Data Analyst / Data Scientist（DA/DS）The core decision-making of Fintech is increasingly dependent on data products and the demand for candidates who can write SQL + Python + business stories is stable.
  • Quantitative Analyst / Quant ResearcherThe pricing and wind-control models of platforms such as Robinhod and Stripe need to be continuously iterative, and students in pure mathematics + programming backgrounds have a natural advantage.
  • Software Engineer (SDE) - Financial Infrastructure DirectionPayment, liquidation, compliance work is less affected by AI and more friendly to L1/OPT.
  • Financial Modeling / Investment Banking（FM）Traditional IB modelling jobs are being reshaped by AI support tools, but there is no reversal in the need for judgement at the Senior level or above.

A cautious direction is needed in the short term:

  • High-standardized positions such as customer support, content review, basic compliance review are the fastest AI replacement areas.
  • Companies that are undergoing lay-offs will experience a gradual reduction in the probability of entry to junior PM positions.

---

What should students do during the lay-offs of the Finnish company?

Retrenchment news tends to push job seekers into two extremes: either panic and avoid the entire industry or blindly drop signals. The right thing to do is...Speed up the layout while the competition is watching.。

Recommendations for specific actions:

  1. The internal priorities are overwhelming.HR will significantly reduce the processing of strange resumes during layoffs, but Hiring Manager's internal push needs will not disappear. Our AI Agent reaches 100+ Hiring Team a week, but it is easier to get a response during the industry cold.
  1. Completing project experience. Get what you can say.: A closing background upgrade (DA / DS / QI / FM / SE) is now completed, and the curriculum vitae was updated by the time the next round of recruitment starts.
  1. Continuous maintenance of LinkedIn networkRetrenchment will release a large number of experienced candidates to the market and increase the intensity of competition; at this point, the internal push value of the Hiring Manager endorsement doubled.
  1. Focus on second-line Finland and traditional financial technology transformationRobinhood is of interest, but the technical posts of Capital One, Fidelity and TD are equally worthy of layout and have more structured support for H1B/OPT candidates.

2026 Finnech References to key time points for finding work:

---

The recruitment tempo will slow in the short term, but strategic optimisation of staff does not usually represent a total freeze on recruitment, and technical placements such as data science, quantification and engineering are likely to reopen in the second half of 2026, with internal push channels more effective than Internet delivery.

If you have not yet entered the post, the redundancy does not directly affect your status; it is a matter of whether the target company still has the H1B drawing of lots and the will of the sponsor. It was suggested that the company's sponsor policy should be clearly recognized at the negotiation stage of the offer, rather than relying solely on historical records.

How do you distinguish between "business force" and "financial crisis"? The core looks at two indicators: first, whether the company ' s latest financial or financing situation is healthy; and second, whether staff reductions are concentrated in specific functions (e.g., customer service, compliance) rather than being exhaustive. This time, Robinhood belonged to the former, and management statements and operational indicators pointed to proactive adjustments.

Isn't it a bad time to vote for Finch now? Not necessarily. Competing parties, while waiting, can instead give more attention to Hiring Manager when his attention is scarce. 56000-g1fwe.title: After the wave of tech layoffs, 56,000 people came to the market. What should we do with students?
56000-g1fwe.dek: After global tech layoffs, job-seekers increased fourfold in a month, and North American students competed in the OPT window with unprecedented cruelty, which tells you how to catch the shock.
56000-g1fwe.body:
In 2026, the global science and technology lay-offs have pushed tens of thousands of engineers and data analysts into the job market at the same time — in India alone, active job seekers from 20 large factories, such as Oracle, Meta, Amazon, have increased by more than 10 times from less than 4,000 a year ago to 56,000+. For North American Chinese students, this means a surge of competitors in the OPT window, a compression of bargaining space for salaries, and more difficult access to H1B sponsorship. The sooner the strategy is adjusted, the better it will emerge in this oversupply market.

---

Key points

  • Market supply surged.The Xpheno study by the professional recruitment agency shows that the number of science and technology workers actively seeking employment increased from 12,000 to 56,000+ in the last month, compared to 4,000 a year ago.
  • Primary and senior posts are the hardest: Xpheno CEO Francis Padamadan has clearly stated that the demand for the ends of entry-lever and senior-suete continues to be low and most affected.
  • Decline in bargaining powerThe ABC Consults partner Ritu Sethi states that the number of active contacts between mid- and senior-level job seekers has increased by 30-35 per cent, "Many people stop obfuscating pay and get offer first."
  • AI/Network still has a chance.According to Pranshu Upadhyay, the regional director of Michael Page, candidates with AI, cybersecurity, cloudy experience are still relatively well-placed.
  • Student OPT window is urgentCompetition has increased the risk of the employer ' s concerns about visas, and Chinese students need to take the initiative of using internal introverted and differentiated backgrounds to gain a limited number of places.

---

How many volumes of science and technology jobs were there in 2026? Data at a glance

According to research conducted by Xpheno on 20 large factories (including Oracle, Meta, Dell, Cisco, Amazon, with over two thirds of them based in the United States), the number of active job seekers has risen exponentially over the past 12 months:

Time nodesNumber of active job seekers (from 20 large factories)
One year ago (approximately June 2025)Less than 4,000
Six months ago (approximately December 2025)About 5,000 people
A month ago (approximately May 2026)About 12,000 people
Current (June 2026)More than 56,000

It's not linear growth. It's an explosive influx. Xpheno CEO Francis Padamadan characterizes this as "a combination of global events and geopolitical challenges that upsets the pace of corporate recruitment", and the overall recruitment rate of the science and technology industry is at a disadvantage.

The most direct impact on students:

  • Behind each data anallyst, SDE, quant, the number of competitors is no longer the same.
  • The company is dominated by the Backfill, with very few new HCs, and the total number of offers is shrinking.
  • Employers are more conservative on visas - they do not need priority for candidates under the same conditions

---

There's more competition for jobs in OPT windows. What about students?

OPT ' s unemployment period of up to 90 days is the clock that hangs over each student. In the current market, the median time to get the first offer is being lengthened - a message from the staff member on Reddit: "Searching for two months, without an interview phone, is exhausted. Another comment: "Now the market is a nightmare for an early-career data."

List of coping strategies for students:

  1. Shorten the cold start.: Don't wait for the resume to be perfect, it's lateral. OPT's running on the first day.
  2. Use internal thrust instead of blind cast.When the number of job seekers is dozens of times higher than the number of places to be recruited, HR can't read his curriculum vitae. Referral directly bypasses the primary screening.
  3. Priority against direction: AI Project, Cybersecurity, Cloud-based Architecture is the high-placeability direction named by Pranshu Upadhyay; pure CRUD back end and traditional BI competitions are the worst.
  4. Accept the "first landing" strategy.The phenomenon described by Ritu Sethi is even more evident in the group of students left behind - to obtain an offer with a sponsorship qualification and to talk about the pay later.
  5. Actively manage LinkedIn VisibilityThe data show that nearly two thirds of job-seekers have been interacting with Recruiter over the past week, and passive waiting is largely ineffective.

---

H1B sponsorship is becoming more difficult, and how can students improve their chances of success?

The supply and demand structure of H1B itself has not changed (approximately 85,000 places per year, drawing of lots), but external pressure in 2026 has led to a contraction in the willingness of employers to provide sponsorship:

  • There's a huge influx of experienced locals, and employers can fill their jobs without having to bear the cost of a sponsorship.
  • Geopolitical uncertainty (the original text explicitly refers to "overseas talent challenges") makes some firms more cautious about the H1B process.
  • Technical recruitment has been reduced to a low point of nearly 28 months (formerly reported by ET) and overall vacancy reduction

Core logic for improving access to H1B:

PolicyRole
Project experience of obtaining a top/name endorsementHe's in the initial screening phase.
Internalally advance the interview processI'm gonna go around the "no-sponsor" initial HR screening.
Demonstration of high-demand skills such as AI/Data/QuantificationMakes employers think "sponsorship costs are worth it."
Targeting companies with H1B history.Reduce internal approval resistance
Early establishment of Hiring Manager relationsFrom "one of the candidates" to "one of the candidates."

Of the 300+ participants in the Rexpand tutorship, those who received offer from Goldman Sachs, J.P. Morgan, Meta, Google and others, all of whom, without exception, advanced the interview process through mentors — not online. When the market rolls to this level, the channel is much more valuable than the curriculum vitae itself.

---

Common problems

Q: Is there no hope for North America now that there are so many layoffs in technology? Not without hope, but with strategy. AI, cybersecurity, and cloudy orientations remain overstretched; traditional jobs need to be cut out through introverted and differentiated contexts, and the success rate of blind voting is already low.

Q: Can't find a job during OPT. Do you have a "renewal"? OPT allows a cumulative period of 90 days of unemployment, and more than that, the status lapses. If they are in school, they can consider applying for a CPT internship in a substantial project; in addition, they can target a company with a sponsorship as soon as possible to avoid wasting unemployment days in an unproductive process.

Q: Did H1B draw a draw for the sponsorship, or did you give it first? The normal process is to obtain an offer and negotiate the H1B sponsorship clause, which the company submits in its place during the drawing season (generally in March, in April and effective 1 October). You need to work on the ground during the current OPT/STEM OPT until H1B becomes effective.

Q: Are there companies that are absorbing talent after downsizing? According to the Xpheno study, companies such as Deloitte, Google, Microsoft, Salesforce, Accenture and IBM are absorbing this reduction. Goldman Sachs, J. P. Morgan, Capital One, Moody's, among the financial technology companies in Rexpand's battles, are relatively stable in this round of technology winters and are in a very important direction.

Q: Is there any need for background promotion projects as the most competitive candidate? On the contrary, because of the harshest competition for entry-lével (Padamadan), candidates with real project experience + mentor referral candidates can be seen from thousands of résumés. There's no difference. HR has no reason to click your resume.

---

The essence of the current market is:The surge in the supply of talent x the shrinking of jobs x the visa threshold Lift HighThe triple pressure also plays a role in the job seekers of students. Staying in place and other market improvements are not a strategy — the only controllable path in the moment is to proactively set up internal push channels, sharpen the direction of high demand skills, and get effective offer in the OPT window at the shortest possible time.

pwc-ds-aj4ap.title: PwC report: Data posts are being divided, and where is the DS for students?
pwc-ds-aj4ap.dek: Twenty-four-year-old Meta data scientist was cut off and "lost" to AI, and the PwC report reveals that SQL and Python are no longer enough and that complex skills are the moat that keeps the student data posts.
pwc-ds-aj4ap.body:
In May 2026, Moyan Chen, a 24-year-old data scientist, was laid off less than a year after working for the Instagram team, and her first reaction was "as relieved of her burden" — because the weeks of waiting for notice of the layoffs were far harder than the layoffs themselves. The AI Employment Report issued by PwC that year confirmed her judgment:The jobs in SQL, Python and basic data processing alone are rapidly disappearing, while the demand for complex talent that combines business judgement and technology is on the rise. For North American Chinese students who are seeking employment in the OPT/H1B window, this is not a alarm but a professional signal requiring immediate action.

---

Key points

  • Meta, the May 2026 lay-offs affected a large number of data posts.The first-line DS profile confirms that it is no longer safe to write only queries and run indicators.
  • PwC AI Employment Report: AI is creating occupational segmentation - the pay of highly skilled people is rising and the loss of low-skilled single jobs is accelerating.
  • "It's not enough to write SQL."Future DS needs to understand products, operations and strategies, not just technology implementation.
  • Additional risk addition for students: The time window for OPT / H1B identity has very low tolerance and layoffs directly trigger the identity crisis.
  • It's safer to transform than to wait.Complementing operational composite capacity, early in-winding, is currently the most effective hedging strategy.

---

What happened to DS/DA when Meta was laid off in 2026?

Moyan Chen, in an interview with Business Insider, recalled that the rumor that Meta lay-offs had begun in March 2026 but that the staff had been late in knowing the exact time.She leaves the office every Tuesday night, and she's not sure if she'll be able to swipe in tomorrow.– Because Meta chose Wednesday executive layoffs on several occasions. This "unresolved" that lasted several weeks was more destructive at the psychological level than the downsizing itself.

Chen felt relieved when he officially laid off his staff on 20 May. But more importantly, she's replaying:

  • She does a lot of routine work with the Instagram team...Write SQL queries, generate visualization, track basic indicators- The AI tool can be completed with high accuracy.
  • She even said, "Ai's created queries are accurate enough that I don't have to review them manually every time."
  • Her conclusion is straight and clear:If you only write codes, run SQL, analyze indicators with Python, this career path is no longer robust."

This is highly consistent with the core judgement of the PwC 2026 AI Employment Report: AI is rewarding jobs with composite human skills (strategic judgement, communication, cross-functional collaboration) and penalizing purely technical executive levels.

---

Which DS/DA positions are the most dangerous? Which ones are the safest?

Based on Moyan Chen ' s first-line experience and trends reported by PwC, it is possible to divide the data category into two categories:

Type of postCore skillsAI alternative riskTrends
Basic data analyst (statement/indicator tracking)SQL、Excel、DashboardVery high.Number of jobs contracted
Traditional data scientists (modelling/A-B tests)Python, Statistics, ML FoundationHighThe job threshold has been significantly increased.
Business-type data scientists (product + strategy + data)Technical + business judgement + communicationMediumDemand is stable and even growing.
Data + AI Product ManagerData Background + PM CapabilityLowNew and high demand positions
Quantitative/financial data scientistsData + Financial Modelling + Field KnowledgeMedium LowSlower hit by AI but not immune

Chen himself said:It was felt that a shift to the financial sector would be safer, as the financial adoption of AI might be slowerI don't know. But at the same time, she asked: "What kind of industry can it really be?"

Her suggestion is that instead of jumping to a slower ship, we should build the truly scarce capacity of the AI era in any industry.Understand business issues, understand product logic, be able to judge in uncertainty。

---

What happens when students get laid off? What about OPT/H1B identity?

This is an issue that Moyan Chen did not address in depth in the interview, but which is critical to the audience of North American students.

Retrenched during OPT:

  • STEM OPT holder has been dismissed 60-day unemployment grace periodOver and above trigger identity violations.
  • A new professional full-time job must be found within 60 days, or a change of legal status (e.g. return to school).
  • The window for finding a new job is extremely short and it is almost impossible to get an offer within 60 days without an in-house push in advance.

H1B holders have been laid off:

  • The same thing happened when H1B was dismissed. 60-day grace period(Grace Period, after 2017).
  • A new employer needs to be found to submit H1B Transfer or to leave/conversion within 60 days.

Key findings: The tolerance rate for students is much lower than for local citizens. Chen can "think the next step slowly" because she has Meta's severance pay buffer and she says she can go back to China.Most of the students still in the OPT/H1B window do not have this buffer space.

IdentityExpiration grace periodElements to be completedOverdue consequences
STEM OPTCumulative upper limit of 60 days of unemploymentFind a new professional employer.Identity violations. Need to leave.
H1B60 days Grace PeriodH1B Transfer or departureIllegal residence
F1 studentsNot applicableKeep reading full-time.—
Data source: The USCIS Network of Officials regulates the duration of OPT unemployment and H1B Grace Period; consults licensed immigrant lawyers on specific issues of status.

---

In 2026, how was the specific transition of DS/DA students?

Moyan Chen gave her directional judgment, and we put together an operational path with 300+ participant experience:

Her proposal (rewritten):

" Future data scientists need a broader knowledge base that can cut across different fields, rather than just deep tilling techniques. AI is creating a demand for talent to understand business issues, product logic and strategy."

Rexpand tutors' transition path (the high-win direction we have seen):

  1. From purely technical DS complex DS
  • Supplementing Financial Modeling or Quantifying Investment
  • Get related project experience + referral from an active mentor
  • Target companies: Goldman Sachs, J.P. Morgan, Moody's, Capital One, Fidelity, etc.
  1. Upgrade from DA → Data Science (DS)
  • Systematically supplement ML modelling + statistical extrapolation capacity
  • Operational experience gained through closing projects that can be included in curricula vitae
  1. Outreach to AI products/strategy
  • Complement product thinking and communication in the existing technical context
  • Applies participants with 1-2 years of work experience who wish to transform

Chen's own choice — entrepreneurship/AI coaching — is suitable for a few, but for most of the students who are still on the job search window, it's not possible to find a job.The first priority is to set up an internal push channel for the next stop before being laid off, rather than to wait until the layoffs are notified.

---

Common problems

Is Data Scientists Retrenched by Meta because of AI? It is not possible to generalize, but Moyan Chen ' s personal history shows that AI has indeed taken over a significant proportion of her daily tasks (writing queries, basic analysis) in her work, which is directly linked to the decision to retrench the staff. The PwC report also noted that the Executive Level Data Set was one of the fastest replacement categories for AI.

Only SQL and Python. Can you find a job in 2026? It's getting harder, especially in large factories. Chen said, "If you only write SQL queries, run Python indicators, it's not a promising career path. " It is recommended that business understanding, product thinking or knowledge of the field (financial, medical, supply chain, etc.) be supplemented immediately for differentiation.

In Rexpand, AI Agent is actively reaching 100+Hiring Team per week and can produce 5-15 opportunities within a short period of time.

Is it true that the financial sector is immune to the impact of AI? Chen himself has reservations about this. It is true that the financial sector is somewhat slow, but in no way immune. At the same time, the composite context of financial + data is still relatively scarce, and there is a continuing demand for data-capable finance from institutions such as Goldman Sachs and J.P. Morgan.
